**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

So now, you see why I had to email you today. What happens over the next 71 days, will affect our country and your life for decades to come. Everything is at stake, and I need you to pay attention before things get worse. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. body:
The letter enclosed.
Dear Peter,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, “You don’t complain about things, you fix them.”

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That’s why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I’m doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

body:
I have a rare moment of free time, and I’ve always found unscheduled time to be the best time to reflect.
#

I have a rare moment of free time, and I’ve always found unscheduled time to be the best time to reflect. As I was thinking about how much grassroots supporters like you have done for our campaign, I thought I should reach out to you directly to tell you why I decided to run for Senate and why your support is so important to our success.
As Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, I saw up close how justice was too often out of reach for people. I saw the ways laws handed down by Washington leave our families behind and how the wealthy and well-connected use our broken status quo to get ahead.
The truth is Washington has failed to deliver for our families, and I knew this race was a real opportunity for North Carolinians to have a change. We need a leader in the Senate who will break through the division and gridlock to stand up for the people.
Despite winning statewide twice, I knew this race would be unlike any challenge I’d taken on before. These Senate races are just so big and expensive — and honestly, they can get nasty. I knew I’d have to lean on more folks than I ever have before for support to pull this off — especially when we’re trying to do it the right way by rejecting corporate PAC money.
Honestly, I wish what we’d already raised would be enough because I hate to ask for money. But outside groups have already spent $8 million on behalf of my opponent before a single vote has been cast, and we know there are tens of millions of dollars more headed our way.
It takes an enormous amount of resources to run a campaign that can organize and speak to the hopes and needs of voters from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike. But that is what it is going to take to win, so with an important fundraising deadline just one day away, I need to ask:
[**Can you please contribute $3 to our campaign before our end-of-month deadline to help us flip North Carolina’s Senate seat? The only way we can secure the real change Washington has failed to deliver is if we are in this fight together.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220830-4-MA&t=1&akid=1608%2E357359%2ED7CMB6)

Whether it’s a test or not - I’m not taking any chances. While Oregon’s 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, **it’s ripe for the picking**.

**[If you’re on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=ec09a3ff2ee94aa1a245d4b6391387f9&_e=6CuGxYGu1RePt_6x6mdUAXqhuOPewmfX0fFlQ8E2p3S6ecgdfpGHBdDEBWG5gigBRr-S57Nap0M6nVJGuGN96zPDPWW7Hw7Vzptj-7gh59c3h7CpxiX11P9_M5ApBRr_qmukHbVW39VReSHhDQ3O7cu1Ne67UYXP6qV9OQxisXv5rTJyKxHyJPEgH92GwoZr99Mi8PpUh452fvgtFE-mJUDpTL8XYqjNKyrxON9cvNOGKW5wBEW4PrSUJRYbxUNjF6idzk0rzd7yZxc2KO1Py69Wfj0e5zEwvuWp7ufBLA4Pvh6bJ7T2Bec4Qe4-pUqci4guNB61aNCU-eHiYvUGPHYPrR2OqwsrG70HPI--Nlsn8H5vd5G0BjzFEb_Tc2o9B52FC5D3aPlHYicfZ88S_A%3D%3D)**

clean_body: It’s critical that we protect and expand our majorities in this year’s midterm elections. | | Derek -- When I accepted the Democratic Party’s nomination for vice president two years ago this month, I spoke about a vision of our nation where all are welcome -- no matter what we look like, where we come from, or who we love. It’s the vision that made my own life possible. The vision that makes the American promise -- for all its complexities and imperfections -- a promise worth fighting for. And it’s the vision that Democrats are working toward every day. But with incredibly slim congressional majorities and exactly 70 days until the midterm elections, we must redouble our efforts and elect Democrats up and down the ballot to continue pursuing that promise. Can I count on you to make your first $7 donation of the year to the DNC ahead of our party’s critical end-of-month deadline? All of the progress that we’ve made so far -- historic investments in our roads and bridges, lowering costs for workers and families, action on gun violence, and more -- was made possible thanks to the Democratic majorities that supporters like you helped elect. But the simple truth is that if we don’t keep investing in the future success of our party now, we could risk losing our congressional majorities and threatening all of the progress we’ve made so far. So I’m asking: Thank you for all that you do, Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States Kamala Harris: Derivative of Adam Schultz / Biden for President Photo. Friend, there is nothing more anti-democratic than voters being forced to vote under maps that have **_already_** been deemed likely illegal gerrymanders by the courts.

But in Ohio, Georgia, Alabama, and Louisiana, that’s exactly what’s happening: | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50007600/364283767/299236001?amount=20&refcode=20220830.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjlkNzFkNmQwLWQ0MjgtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EWvK5V2kdx_uMytzcLr1g1GUwexif3WZZ5AG0dks6lg=)

* In each of these states, Republicans passed blatantly gerrymandered maps that were struck down by courts.
* But then, instead of following court orders to submit new, fair maps, Republicans _stalled_. In some cases, they wasted time repeatedly resubmitting maps that were nearly identical to the original, rejected ones.
* Finally, after the GOP ran out the clock, the Trump Supreme Court (surprise, surprise) essentially _rewarded_ this behavior by ruling that it’s now too close to the election to implement new maps!

Now, with mail-in and early voting starting in some states _next month_ , millions of voters will be forced to cast their ballots in elections where they already know the deck is stacked.

**Here’s how the NDRC is fighting back: We’re investing in target races across the country to hold gerrymandering politicians accountable and help elect Democracy Defenders who will protect the future of free and fair elections. name: Dr. Oz
subject: Put some skin in the game 👉
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Stand for America PAC
body:
It all comes down to this
| |
---
| | | |
---
| Peter,

It's Dr. Oz. I've given out a lot of advice on skincare over my long career.

But now I'm asking you to put some skin in the game.

The future of our country will be determined this November in states like Pennsylvania. Pennsylvania is the Democrats' best shot at adding a Democrat seat and expanding their very slim Senate majority.

The far Left's policies are destroying our country, prioritizing their dangerous woke liberal agenda over the very real needs of the American people.

In fact, my opponent even said he doesn't think the administration has gone far enough!

---
| | [SQUASH FETTERMAN'S SOCIALIST AGENDA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61146889:JV8kqEVMN:m:1:3331421248:A999E68FAED7FA332112659D45243476:r)
---

Skyrocketing crime. Record-breaking homicide. Families living in fear. This is the result of radical soft-on-crime policies championed by Fetterman and the far Left.

I am not playing around here. We have less than **70 days** till Election Day, and our resources are dangerously low. Without your support, we can't air TV ads to counter the far-left smear campaigns and mobilize volunteers to get out the vote this November.

That's why I'm asking for your help. If I am going to have any shot of defeating my socialist opponent, I need 543 grassroots supporters to step up now.

---
| | [STEP UP NOW: BECOME A GRASSROOTS SUPPORTER](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61146889:JV8kqEVMN:m:1:3331421248:A999E68FAED7FA332112659D45243476:r)
---

**If we lose Pennsylvania we 'll never be able to flip the Senate RED and save our country from the radical Left.**

Radical liberals like AOC and Elizabeth Warren are eager to have my opponent John Fetterman join their squad in DC. We cannot afford to have socialist leaders running Pennsylvania.

I first decided to run for Senate to give a voice to the voiceless. But now I'm on the front lines of the struggle against the rising tide of socialism.

This race is our one chance to hand the radical Left a crushing defeat and finally turn things around.

If we lose this fall, then it'll be two more years of Democrat control and their dangerous radical policies. Without your support, our country doesn't stand a chance.

My opponent, John Fetterman, will be just another rubber stamp for Democrats' reckless policies. We can't let this Bernie Sanders wannabe double down on Biden's failed agenda and lead us further down the road to socialism.

---
| | [STOP SOCIALISM IN ITS TRACKS](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61146890:JV8kqEVMN:m:1:3331421248:A999E68FAED7FA332112659D45243476:r)
---

We must have you on **OUR** side if we are going to take back the Senate and get our country back on track.

I'm not afraid of a few leftist agitators, Peter,, but I could really use your help in this crucial battleground election.

_**[Every single dollar we raise today will make an outsized impact and will be the difference between victory and defeat.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61146889:JV8kqEVMN:m:1:3331421248:A999E68FAED7FA332112659D45243476:r "Every single dollar
we raise today will make an outsized impact and will be the difference between victory and defeat. ")**_

Your contribution will put us one step closer to winning back the Senate and implementing the common sense solutions that our nation desperately needs.

_**[Can I count on you to put some skin in the game with a quick $25 contribution?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61146889:JV8kqEVMN:m:1:3331421248:A999E68FAED7FA332112659D45243476:r "Can I count on you
to put some skin in the game with a quick $12 contribution?")

[$25 may not seem like much in a race this big. But trust me, every little bit helps.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61146889:JV8kqEVMN:m:1:3331421248:A999E68FAED7FA332112659D45243476:r "$12 may not seem like much in a race this big. But trust me, every little bit helps.")**_

Thank you for your generous support,

Dr. Oz

| | | **_
_****_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. name: Herschel Walker
subject: I've fallen behind! 😬
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Stand for America PAC
body:
| |
---
| | |
Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised $17 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61145563:6AZ7UEVNw:m:1:3334294963:CE74F9D07C52CA0FE79180CB2FD92A22:r "It’s important that we band
together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61145563:6AZ7UEVNw:m:1:3334294963:CE74F9D07C52CA0FE79180CB2FD92A22:r "It’s
important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Peter, I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $25 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Every penny counts, and your help is CRITICAL.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61145563:6AZ7UEVNw:m:1:3334294963:CE74F9D07C52CA0FE79180CB2FD92A22:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it
takes to pull off a win.")**_

Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?"
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zlv4291inaea4apt2r7mnpk7bj522f7tplgdirkg_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjgm0o36c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf9oj6ejimctb3c2qn4c7668rm6sr1esqb4p75e1o6ctj4meqb4t3l6mon4otlmurt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj9cr4sup30phkcapm4ptgmlin49fg)
| | | This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp9qt4kaevan8r9jj4vbeos58nk2iusmtg63ult8_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjgm0o36c5h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgq9qj156m6jvdmd63hsjt1tn7ru1lkojtq5mkkg_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjgm0o36c5h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. | | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2znaorpap73kj4hlmmv7fj3ndf2ctkn88t6kcs83g_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjgmcor1chh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

> PRESS RELEASE
Vikram Means Business Vikram Mansharamani Releases a Book of His Ideas to Make the Granite State Grow

---
CONCORD, NH - August 31, 2022 - Today, first generation American, businessman, and U.S. Senate candidate Vikram Mansharamani unveiled a brand-new book entitled Vikram Means Business, which is a concise collection of his thoughts and positions on the most pressing issues facing America and the world today. See the table of contents below.
---
| Table of Contents
Introduction: The American Dream Why I'm Running Fighting Inflation Confronting China Addressing Iran Battling Cancel Culture Securing The Border Education & Choice The Business of Governing Conclusion: A Nation Worth Preserving
---
| On the release of his new publication, Vikram states: "My campaign for the U.S. Senate has led me to really delve into the problems that face America today. As someone who has lived the American Dream, I remain concerned about whether our kids will have the same opportunities that many of us have had. Our country is off track and we need to ensure equal opportunity for all."
Vikram continued: "Most candidates really only have talking points, but I want voters to see how I think about the issues. The issues of the day may change over time and it's therefore essential that voters understand my approach."
Vikram's book is a key part of the campaign's final push to the primary election on September 13th. Vikram for New Hampshire is one of two campaigns on TV and Vikram is tirelessly criss-crossing the state and outworking the competition. This book, as well as Vikram's participation in debates over the next two weeks, will help Granite Staters make an informed choice when they vote next month. As Vikram has repeatedly stated, career politicians have broken the economy. It's going to take a Businessman to fix it.
Vikram Means Business is currently available as a free download via the campaign's website [https://vikram4nh.com/book](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dHtcnhCqxktDTcfD8fjxuQgvZB41_G6IsjGUs_OAO2CN3UgtNT2CxT9HpvGOQILXFg0KqH0Krn4Rd_SA8hWudJBti-7uBQuNAK_pmPC2mAC3XsW7_Kx8zlB8vaYrXG0DFaF4YRIHhROCWMs3s_ZBSg==&c=Zf97AOnlgE0oc-W0wRneJi0N-3W3rJjmmx7sdBe9H_9_VUYaxNRk-Q==&ch=xG7jwFoKk4m85ba7zBYV9c3rHMVoAdJuJNKkeC60Vw6bCxm8KIz8XQ==).

name: Rep. Brady Williamson
subject: Buying Votes with Other-Peoples-Money
body:
Buying Votes with Other Peoples Money By Brady WilliamsonA few years ago, I believed the current policy makers were trying to buy votes. Today I am certain they are pursuing destruction of all tha | |
---

| | | Buying Votes with Other Peoples Money |
---|---|---
| By Brady WilliamsonA few years ago, I believed the current policy makers were trying to buy votes. Today I am certain they are pursuing destruction of all that is good in our nation. "Student debt forgiveness" is a prime example. This Administration is fostering a weak and lazy generation that views hard work and determination in pursuit of success and family as foolishness.Some risk their lives serving in the military for a few years to fund their children's education. Some earn money to put themselves and their children through college to earn degrees that have value. Some work two or three jobs while in school. Some wise parents and grandparents set a little aside for the future education of their children. Some bypass a college education to go straight to work in occupations that not only pay well but are in high demand across the country. None of those groups matter to this Administration. Their hard work, wise decisions, avoidance of debt, or repayment of their own debt is all now going to fund those who expect someone else to satisfy the terms of an agreement they had no part in. Groups making decisions that should be encouraged are penalized. Groups that made bad financial decisions are being propped up.[Take the Survey - What do you think about Biden's student loan forgiveness plan?](https://www.votervoice.net/MSFreedomCaucus/Surveys/8036/Respond)In my house, that would be called bad parenting, and would lead to entitled, dependent children, who cannot stand on their own two feet. But in the White House it's called caring for those in need. There is a reason they are in need, and there is a reason why there is a growing number of our population that are dependent on government instead of their God-given abilities, their families, their churches, and the sweat of their brow. Debt was not an option for me during college, nor was begging for my family's financial support. I look back and thank God for it. During college, I literally shoveled horse manure in a barn, cut the grass of many homes and businesses, served food and cleaned dishes. I thoroughly enjoyed the work almost as much as I enjoyed the people I worked for, and I am a better person for it. I lived cheaply and worked hard, somehow managed to get a degree in Accounting, the basics of which made sense to me. Graduating with no debt also made sense to me. So, yes, this Administration is buying votes. In fact, I'd put my money (not your money) on them buying their way out of office through these decisions. [Voice Your Opinion - Take the Survey](https://www.votervoice.net/MSFreedomCaucus/Surveys/8036/Respond) |
| Brady Williamson, Vice-Chairman Mississippi Freedom Caucus |
---|---|---
| |
---

body:
I'm curious to know: do you plan to vote Republican in this year's midterm elections? Or are you planning to vote for an Independent/Democrat?

|
Peter,

I'm curious to know whether you plan to vote Republican in this year's midterm election.**[Please let me know that my fellow conservative candidates around the country and I can count on your support. ](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60686152:sHEQB-hSN:m:1:2247059263:EAF25E5D6BE2ADD0D93747C9E7A3F9D2:r)**

[** LET ME KNOW IF YOU PLAN TO VOTE ➞ **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60686152:sHEQB-hSN:m:1:2247059263:EAF25E5D6BE2ADD0D93747C9E7A3F9D2:r)
Democrats have proven once again that they are disconnected from reality. Time and again,**they pass reckless tax increases they claim will only affect the wealthiest 1%, but in reality end up affecting every working class American.**

Senate Democrats just voted - without the support of a single Republican - to raise taxes and increase federal spending by $740 BILLION over the next decade.

Thanks to Biden and Pelosi, everyday Americans are already struggling to pay for everything. Some are taking on second jobs to make ends meet. But in these tough times, Democrats' priorities seem to be raising taxes, raising energy prices, raising consumer prices, all while creating political theater to distract the public from their destructive policies.

**This is unconscionable. It's Un-American.**

We deserve better. Which is why I need you to commit to going out to vote on November 8th.

Do you really want to keep people in charge who:

1. Spend our money like there's no tomorrow
2. Pay people not to work
3. And raise taxes even more for those who are working?

**[Let me know if you plan to vote today.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60686152:sHEQB-hSN:m:1:2247059263:EAF25E5D6BE2ADD0D93747C9E7A3F9D2:r)**

For freedom,

Jim Jordan

It's a reminder that in the end, the only fealty Republicans like Kemp have is to power and party, and Kemp cares only about keeping his GOP base happy, not our democracy._ [**We must elect Stacey Abrams Georgia Governor. Would you consider donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can to make this incredible fighter, rising star and liberal voice the next Governor of Georgia?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td1935a54-f7eb-47be-ad5d-34c2bc004f0c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
This shouldn't surprise anyone who followed how he beat Stacey Abrams in 2018, using his position as Secretary of State in Georgia to suppress scores of Democratic votes, particularly among voters of color. He lacked the integrity and decency to recuse himself from refereeing his own election, because, again, what matters to Kemp is not the will or welfare of the people of Georgia, but his lust for power.

name: Jay Jones
subject: ICYMI: My op-ed in support of abortion rights
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Friends of Jay Jones
body:
| | | [](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/Kh2Tu9_eXpNORJLdOn9xavCnr2LP-FzXl5frsvkNM8Y=)
---
Friend -- I hope you will take a moment to read my recent op-ed in _The Roanoke Times_ in support of abortion rights. Virginia shines brightly as a safe haven for women in the mid-Atlantic, protecting what should still be their constitutional freedom to make their own health care choices, and we must do everything in our power to keep it that way.
# [**_The Roanoke Times_ : Jones: To maintain Virginia's standing, leave abortion rights intact**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/xfIbqzGfUfSMKcUE0ph40HcAzbDkG3Wo20_-VZhWrNU=)
When the Supreme Court upended the settled legal landscape with its decision in Dobbs -- stripping away the explicit right to privacy that Americans enjoyed for nearly 50 years -- abortion rights assumed center stage in the political discourse at every level of government. Make no mistake, the simplest solution to preserve the legacy of Roe v. Wade is federal legislation enacted by Congress, enshrining the right to choose in statutory text. However, given that razor thin margins in both chambers render immediate action all but impossible, it falls to the states to protect reproductive healthcare and prioritize women's health. Many Virginians assume this battle will inevitably be fought here as well -- and they're absolutely right. While the [**resounding defeat**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/qQzbTKKwwCzukEBmDccf18aGBh2Kef0CUb1gfUb_HK0=) of a constitutional amendment that sought to limit abortion rights in ruby-red Kansas offers a glimmer of hope for the pro-choice movement, similar successes cannot be guaranteed elsewhere. Only a few days after the Kansas vote, Indiana became the first state to pass a major restriction since Dobbs. Our neighboring states, including [**West Virginia**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/xL3EjAhn2-uqCfhjnufCrVp9mbbHt9KpOmbO5_Eay5w=), [**Tennessee**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/oJ3DtOmtRvqPGuBIThYOjzTJi9lfjEltjR3-fVMG4J4=), and [**Kentucky**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/k6HXayb9hT53ZRybIc7D7ro_ED0vFZiZ58K2KdKQWps=?id=87801481) have already initiated steps to restrict abortion, and [**North Carolina**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/cgMAiubsd3gg5wVl2p3W_EzsC1CO0N5Urv09tEDPyvA=)'s 20-week ban was just reinstated. It is notable that in the immediate aftermath of the Supreme Court's politicization of Americans' fundamental rights, [**major pharmaceutical company Eli Lilly announced it would expand elsewhere rather than Indiana in order to retain and attract talent for its workforce**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/XLLOXp0nCi7Q9Yj41ilGAwjs5RIsmbMewksQPwkzVJY=). It isn't at all hard to imagine this trend continuing as other states enact bans inspired by the Hoosier State. At the moment, Virginia shines brightly as a safe haven for women in the mid-Atlantic, protecting what should still be their constitutional freedom to make their own health care choices. This commitment remains steadfast among the majority of citizens of our commonwealth, and Virginians of all stripes are working to protect abortion access because it's the right thing to do. And yet, Gov. Glenn Youngkin, who was caught on tape during his campaign telling a supporter he couldn't talk about abortion and win the election, but promised he wouldn't "[**get squishy**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/eoYn5Z3qzBO84itqcCYcj3Ni8_cGguqDibe1TKWQ87o=)" on his anti-choice stance, indicated he intends to send down an early-term abortion ban to the General Assembly. Unsurprisingly, he [**convened an all-Republican working group to craft the legislation**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/cfGH0sGXZSHurvQ0U6DqVhLnwyuD9IjbIaae__ef2xE=). Virginians overwhelmingly reject the governor's extreme position. In fact, recent polling suggests that the governor is far out of step with the vast majority of Virginians. Indeed, [**77% of the electorate believes that abortion decisions should be made by women, not politicians**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/E1EaSQgnERQ7xv7wW1c4g8LGpiI5TKIeQ48EtuOtOnM=). Yet the governor has indicated that he would rather the government lunge headfirst into the sanctity of the doctor-patient relationship and strip away the freedom to make one's own medical decisions. As the leader of the party that bills itself as the champion of "limited government," Youngkin seems intent on ushering in the starkest instance of government intrusion into our lives in generations. It seems the governor is troubled by neither the hypocrisy of his position, nor the far-reaching effects such a ban would have on the most vulnerable citizens of our commonwealth. With an [**attorney general hell-bent on inserting himself into women 's private decisions**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/n6P4i5UlPTxM1NZdGzC4GGJYnGuXQtbO_JAqtpQZ3GI=) as well, our legislature and local governments become more critical in maintaining Virginia's current healthcare system. With looming elections at both levels, abortion may end up as the most important issue on the table -- and our only hope of stopping a total backslide into the regressive realities of a pre _-Roe_ world. Beyond that, community organizations become the last line of defense. I stand ready to support women seeking safe and legal abortions in the Commonwealth. Dozens of like-minded groups are already marshaling resources to protect these rights here at home, in particular in our urban and rural communities. The thread of hope and progress in this country has frequently run through Virginia, beginning with the founding of our democracy and continuing through our recent successes under former Gov. Ralph Northam and the Democratic majorities in the legislature. We cannot let the zealousness of out-of-step minority rule threaten the health, safety, and welfare of women in our commonwealth. We don't want our economy to be impacted when major businesses flee or choose to expand beyond Virginia, nor do we want to slip in our rankings for [**workers**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/4WqToXJyFceStgrbqme94NlTe5k7XQvPhUhFwzl9TLA=) and [**business**](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/YD4ir7ITAVeTlQmXEbmtAZuwmoPmpYGY_JAk8OBlyrQ=). We want women to feel safe and protected within our borders. I urge Youngkin to listen to the widely held views of Virginians and disband his working group immediately. Staying the course and maintaining Virginia's current abortion framework is our only hope from upending our steady progress and putting our collective future in jeopardy. \- Jay

| [](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/m7WO5uba8Nm5TPTvgEdHLh3X-T1qr56uaXm1LYZ0wk0=) [](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/_u4jd56b3R1vmwAOiXigYj4aIeZAEhHibJOJNuIamuo=)[](https://act.myngp.com/el/XbFi1nnJSQ8GJJGegSR-Iz4jWbvpx931YHf5zuczA6Q=/UJuyhTG-7du7700uPnSDb7pgDYZL4yctdDB6U1Z9vvI=) | Paid for and authorized by Friends of Jay Jones

August 31, 2022
Dear friend,
We're still overflowing with gratitude that voters once again voted for progress, for Our Next Era. We couldn't have won this campaign without your support.
Because of your phone calls, texts, door-knocking, yard sign deliveries, and contributions [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lee-harris-for-county-mayor-1] to this campaign, we can continue to build on the progress made over the last four years. The gains over the last four years under Mayor Harris' leadership are no small potatoes, by the way. There are thousands of workers who now make a living wage [https://www.actionnews5.com/2022/05/08/shelby-county-mayor-lee-harris-proposes-16-billion-budget/] . There have been historic investments in pre-k [https://www.localmemphis.com/article/news/local/shelby-county-mayor-lee-harris-announces-first-time-pre-k-funding-of-its-kind/522-0df050e8-85d7-4639-89aa-ebf8e206aef2] to ensure that every family has access, regardless of income. There have been a host of public safety [https://dailymemphian.com/article/26502/mayor-lee-harris-pay-raises-corrections-officers] and criminal justice reforms [https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/news/local/2020/07/27/shelby-county-ban-box-job-application-criminal-history/5519279002/] .
Thanks to your hard work & support, we have another four years of leadership that prioritizes the needs of working families and neighborhoods. We have the opportunity before us to continue expanding healthcare access and second chance programs.

As someone who's familiar with the business of campaigning and the business of public service, I want to encourage you to stay involved. Right now, you can find more information about how to get involved in Mayor Harris' transition planning, other ways to volunteer, and career opportunities in Shelby County Government by visiting www.OURNEXTERA.com [http://www.OURNEXTERA.com] . The important work starts now and no effort that benefits our community can be done by a singular individual. It takes a coalition, a diverse group of organizations and people to move the needle on important issues. Team Harris will continue to keep you in the loop on what's coming down the pike.
I hope we'll be standing shoulder-to-shoulder again soon in the efforts to improve the lives of working families.
In Gratitude,
Alex Hensley

That was the Black community and that was our dreams and hopes at that time...That is not the dreams and hopes of the Biden Administration. Soros-funded radicals allowing criminals to run rampant in the streets, destroying businesses and communities

name: Charlie Crist
subject: extremism in Florida
body:
Derek,
It sickens me to have to write this: Recently, a group of hateful extremists carrying Nazi flags rallied outside a conservative conference here in Florida to show their support for Governor Ron DeSantis.
He still has yet to condemn or disavow them.
Unfortunately, this is part of a pattern for Governor DeSantis. He has long been willing to encourage hateful extremists in order to serve his own political ambitions.
Because our current governor has failed to state the obvious, let me be clear: Nazis have no place in our Florida. Period .
The only way to stop DeSantis' dangerous and divisive brand of politics is to stop it dead in its tracks. I can do that. Throughout my years of public service, I've always won by bringing people together. But I can't do it alone.
Can you help me stop DeSantis by splitting a donation between my campaign and CommonGood right now? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220830_CGVA_Crist]
I know the people of Florida. As a state, we are deeply committed to respecting each other, our differences, and the common human dignity that binds us together. We don't just love our country — we love our fellow countrymen.
That's why I'm so disturbed when I see our governor embracing the MAGA playbook. Whether it's failing to condemn Nazis, demonizing members of the LGBTQ community, or trying to take away women's freedom to control their own bodies, it's out of step with Florida values and it's wrong.
This November, we can beat Governor DeSantis and send a message that his extreme MAGA style of politics has no home here in Florida. But that will only happen if people of conscience are willing to step up and pitch in.
I am running for Governor to stand up against DeSantis and the extreme faction that he encourages within the Republican party. If you're ready to bring values-based leadership back to our state, I hope you'll support my campaign today by splitting a donation with CommonGood today. body:
| | Team, my name is Paul Begala. I worked in the White House back when if you lost an election, you cleared out your desk and left an encouraging note for the next person — no matter their party affiliation. Now, Republicans are throwing tradition and morality out the window in pursuit of the ultimate award: a Trump endorsement. **In 2022, there are three types of Republican officials:**
* The conspiracy theorists like Lauren Boebert,
* The courageous like Liz Cheney, and;
* The cowards like Kevin Kiley.

| | | Peter, you know I hate to be negative.

I'm genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don't see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn't be more severe and is why I'm asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

Unlike my opponent, I haven't spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that's precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I'm bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I'll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won't put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We're creeping into the final hours of this month's deadline, but I know that we'll keep this campaign going with your support.

| Dear Peter,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, "You don't complain about things, you fix them."

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That's why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I'm doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save America.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61154596:65p_LoVNf:m:1:3317145305:5A5B1576C98B5E162AE073CEC1A0E5B7:r "Help Republicans retake Congress and save America. >>")**

It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

Dear Peter, The world seems to get crazier every day. More than ever, we need to stick together and help each other. That's our philosophy at PragerU. We continue our work come hell (CRT propaganda, the sexualization of our children) or high water (inflation, recession, or stagflation). If you have seen any PragerU videos, you know we provide much needed common sense content to millions of people 24/7. [**August is PragerU's fundraising month and from now until August 31, generous PragerU donors have committed to tripling all donations-thereby TRIPLING YOUR GIFT!**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.) With inflation and economic uncertainty, many people are not able to give as much as before. But if you give today, your 100% tax-deductible donation will go 3X further and have TRIPLE THE IMPACT. The PragerU team is more committed and working harder than ever to educate young people about our nation's founding principles and values. Those values have sustained America through hard times. They will do so again.
---
[Donate Now](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)

But dark clouds are gathering. We've been getting troubling emails from some of our most dedicated online supporters. Because of the economic downturn, some are saying that they will not be able to help us with a donation this year. Sky high gas prices and bigger grocery bills are overwhelming them. Some have even lost their jobs. **About 40% of PragerU's donations come from individual, online donors, so it makes perfect sense we are tracking behind our budgeted goal. But, this is not the time to scale back our efforts. This is the time to scale up! We need your help to fill this gap.** [Can we count on your tax-deductible support today to help us continue being your voice and fighting for everything you care about? Your gift today will be TRIPLED and have TRIPLE THE IMPACT.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.) In the midst of this terrible uncertainty lies an opportunity to educate Americans, who are spending more time online than ever before, about our shared ideas and values. The better-funded left will use this opportunity to diminish our voice. They are working together right now to find the money to bury our ideas-simply by rapidly investing in their ideology far more than we do. [Thanks to the generous PragerU donors funding this 3X matching campaign, your gift will now have TRIPLE THE IMPACT!](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.) **That means your $50 gift to PragerU turns into $150. Your $250 gift turns into $750. If you give $1,000 to PragerU, your impact explodes to $3,000 in funding to change millions of young minds-and millions of young lives-for the better.**

Just a few presidential elections ago, Missouri was one of the top-targeted swing states in the entire country. And even **as recently as 2016, we had a Democratic senator, a Democratic governor, and Democratic leaders in four other statewide offices. **
**But in recent years, far-right extremists like Josh Hawley were able to ride their way to Washington on Trump's wave of hate.** They sold a lie to families here – showing up to photo ops and making promises left and right. They spread dangerous conspiracy theories and did everything they could to divide our communities and our nation.
The moment these leaders got to Washington, they turned their back on the very families who sent them there. **They cozied up to the corporate lobbyists and spewed hate that went against our proud Missouri values.**
**The people of Missouri are smart, decisive, and ready to turn the page on Trumpism and the GOP's anti-abortion, pro-corporation, right-wing agenda.** That’s why Mitch McConnell and his GOP cronies want to sell you on the lie that the Show Me State is unflippable and solidly red. They know the only way Republicans win this race is if grassroots Democrats sit it out.
This race isn't about changing Missouri. **This is about returning Missouri to its roots and winning our state the honest, bold leader we deserve.**

body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlhsjv12ppl3ke32fhig2ga1ifc4s778ephrvi50_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbq33dbjetir1crkmup66ptielrj8dhm6cq7bddlceo70ttieoob8crn6orr8tlgsv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664qb6p77m9omcc9imdgefc5lclp238h1e8he4933cdi69or4cdj68oh5u)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlg8tglendl33h4lg2ljiql77v47g2q75fuuss9g_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or6chh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---

---

As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

Friend, the general election is officially underway, and with 70 days until Election Day, I'm up against a Trump-backed opponent who is hellbent on flipping this seat to hand control of the Senate over to Mitch McConnell.
So I have a simple question for you: If you knew a donation of $5 would help protect this seat and Democratic control of the Senate, would you donate?
I'm asking because grassroots support from you - right now, at this critical moment - will make all the difference in our fight to protect this seat from an opponent handpicked by Donald Trump.
It will make all the difference in ensuring we can expose and investigate Trump's crimes against our democracy, stopping the Republican Party from covering up his wrongdoings.
It will make all the difference in protecting the fundamental human right to reproductive freedom, keeping the GOP from passing a nationwide abortion ban.
**It will make all the difference in competing against the $23 million that Mitch McConnell has in the bank to flip seats like this one - because when you step up and donate, so do hundreds of other Democrats, fueling our ability to combat McConnell's megadonor machine.**
So humbly, and respectfully, Friend, I'll ask again: **[In the face of my crucial end-of-month fundraising deadline, your donation of $5 or more will make the difference in protecting this seat and Democratic control of the Senate. Can you donate today?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1242-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
I have so much appreciation for all you do. Thank you.
Dick

body:
You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z94k5ur95imdvfieddv3783r89t49bc9063lhq30_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf5dj0ehpbapdhm5grep9kcmpbas5m62r3ad9mccr7asr463ie4ohksli7eppmesrt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj9cr4sup72phh6sqj8dtgmlin49fg)
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z74vn04rt4nd0glne3l01m9ljag279c2ee96sfg8_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)

Friend,

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices
* Universities are running amok with radical socialists
* The mainstream media openly lies to the public
* Corporate America has embraced Woke propaganda
* Pelosi and her cronies are passing a radical agenda in Congress

Despite all this: _**Yes, there is hope for the future**_.

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You'd think I was crazy. Aren't they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...
* Helped pass Constitutional Carry in Texas, Indiana, and Alabama!
* Helped expand School Choice in Kentucky, Arizona, and Missouri!
* Adding over 250 hardcore pro-liberty legislators to a national coalition across the country!
* SUED dozens of college campuses and restored free speech rights to over 1.5 million college students!

College students are lining up to defend Constitutional principles and grow a coalition of liberty legislators across the country. Here's how they are doing it.

Allow me to personally introduce Lauren Daugherty. She is the CEO of Young Americans for Liberty (YAL). YAL is the most active and effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus and in American electoral politics.

**Friend, I told Lauren I would help YAL raise $23,000 online. It will go directly towards YAL 's work to fight for laws that advance liberty, train students to become door knockers before the 2022 elections, and so much more. I am asking for your immediate support now to get 1,000 students mobilized for freedom. **

[_**Donate $10 >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhr9d9ers6ce12rfjpbnepkvjbfc0a5mokvutmug_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate $20.22 >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvpl65uat46kh8q38gve5bcqqkssosp4kj3rhda0_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zje04cql6shst3mmfbr25abf9a2si7k4r3au2b0o_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z294j7ia1kcks4ttj774ns0h8ul855iqd1ja0528_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate $210 to sponsor a student >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvfvc8f3qhl7l82vtffss2jlk8iq85937ii8u418_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate $420 to sponsor two students >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5v9g9qedot7i5k78vsgv0tdhb7661g7121489dg_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z2l0nb4k7rj6gmdigj5oo4tog6gg80ijhlqsefjo_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)

Here's how it works.

> **First:** YAL recruits tens of thousands of students across college campuses. These students start and join an active YAL chapter where they fight back against leftist bias on campus.
>
> **Next:** YAL takes the top student leaders and brings them to top notch trainings. There, students are taught how to transform their campus and fight for liberty candidates and causes in the legislature.
>
> **Then:** Thousands of student activists recruited and trained by YAL knock on doors to push liberty legislation, and turn out the vote for liberty-minded candidates running for office.
>
> **Finally:** These liberty legislators pass bills to defend freedom of speech, protect the 2nd Amendment, and expand free markets.

The results speak volumes of this successful formula to make liberty WIN:

YAL's student activists have helped elect over 250 pro-liberty legislators, repealed 99 unconstitutional free speech codes and regulations, and have started chapters on over 500 college campuses across the country.

All of this hinges on training the next generation of liberty patriots.

Can you join me today to help YAL defend our liberty and train the next generation of liberty activists? Click below to send your urgent support.

[_**Donate $10 >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zkfe1uifiupr6dpii1sapjk8jolehfch22k33l00_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)

[_**Donate $50 >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmsd3hfmf3aaabbltp0has5gqfrcqqbho2ntugg8_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zqatbi2v1nfuothvnshv7jomiioakdelqepi2hb8_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate $210 to sponsor a student >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhum0u0rp60f27bmtnpltv9gtm75on600nkhukv8_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate $420 to sponsor two students >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrdsf1fu9jv8bim3kmhd1nbkemln8ipgjbl3309g_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb8el6b9vfsscdv73nuuv0l2gpqnqrhil9jvta70_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm8or0slh2bs)

In liberty,

Senator Rand Paul

**Chabot Campaign Airs First Television Ad Of 2022 Cycle Highlighting Clear Contrast on the Economy in Race for Congress** _Voters Have Clear Choice Between Steve Chabot’s Record of Fighting to Bring Down Costs and Lower Taxes — and Tax-and-Spend Agenda of Former Pelosi Staffer Greg Landsman_ _ _**For Immediate Release** Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) CINCINNATI – Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign released its first television ad of the 2022 cycle on Wednesday. The ad, called “Fighting,” highlights the contrast between Chabot’s record of fighting for First District families and small businesses and his opponent’s record of supporting tax hikes and Nancy Pelosi-style policies that drive higher costs for families and small businesses. “This election is about the economy and which candidate can be trusted to address inflation, lower costs for families and support small businesses to create more prosperity and greater opportunity for First District communities,” said Chabot for Congress campaign manager John Gomez. “There is a crystal-clear contrast in this race between Congressman Chabot’s record of fighting to lower costs for families and small businesses, and Greg Landsman’s tax-and-spend agenda inspired by his mentor Nancy Pelosi.” “Steve Chabot successfully lowered taxes for First District families, has been a champion for Ohio small businesses and is fighting to bring down gas and grocery costs,” Gomez continued. “Greg Landsman not only bragged about working for Nancy Pelosi and standing behind her tax-and-spend agenda, but he also has a demonstrated track record of supporting Pelosi-style policies on the City Council that increased the burden on families and small businesses.” Watch the ad, “Fighting,” [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6myyGgS7P5ZC6OeNxG95muvP4O2D7C6T0U_t900yrRMINkCXWTvxxlGRSJayL5Dq_oP25_AtzsWjdbAIdt90RU5yswWEJ-lLdV9-ovT4wnq9JCAWaW2dlqxaceVQeZiSnwWAJ707nVEfwPUYKUvZTQY4cjqDw6lhh1VaS2SnizxBYmYt7RPT5bQYL1EmHN-9dw%3D%3D). **GREG LANDSMAN’S AGENDA: PELOSI-STYLE POLICIES AND TAX HIKES THAT INCREASE THE BURDEN ON FAMILIES & SMALL BUSINESSES** _Landsman Stands With Nancy Pelosi and Supports More of Her Tax-and-Spend Agenda That Makes Inflation Worse_
* Landsman is a former staffer for Nancy Pelosi. ([Cincinnati Enquirer](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6kqjQyxV5fjFW3Ja6oDAOmpHnNAfcTjDihBOetaRDPcYWIzMi-Homj4Pwi4yEWgUk2ZYivwjfM15nYRQtwR4S90AvwFipp9TSy4c2dyPMuGhNDPMU3n_60ju6jjenzqI3I1OESM93Q4i_Cls36-FHnvhd8EW4psOMMzgjOlw4_2dJ0NK1c2OeMXfYrEJCHtbiBXm0jbC4YXKdXI2nDTiny5WEOCCHGzcSFbrC7wOoonnBifI1XTj8b0HyrzS2WdO7UIyFn3bo5OUBx33bpmHtA5XqqZionQ6woBHv5uqw-i14d6F6X5ktIoYUb3y3lL63Q%3D%3D), 5/3/22)

* During his campaign for Congress, Landsman said he stands with Pelosi: “I actually worked for Nancy Pelosi... I couldn’t be more excited to hopefully join her as a member of Congress... stand with me and Nancy Pelosi.” ([Landsman for Congress](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6s5vzci1UPGAfWYd3IktZo4CzRmaraWyF4CJMoi78thbyLooiUqdRWhW562ylJ9z-XrcuiwEV-XTK1zyNnesPk2agQuyrJ78fmLivxAKDVy_YRp_AeLBOggKMpoxkefB7AWkTRbC3wHzvW5f_Vhptz-Gzg0DCgV9UVsVvWV49p3xWRD8Pzw5lmyUaiZskm8-D3czU-zdeRK6I_cnjVpqLGsOPcllphj9a5ua4c5Z5tlfKt5ziEYENBnbQiIwsVVIfg%3D%3D), Fundraising Email, 3/30/22)

* Landsman [dismissed](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6o2Dy743EQAt5O-wDwSvs8Iu3nbGO6KBVt1I9BaASpK3OW8wuI1ka210TZXPYhqSXyhMyplqFQDQKfMSlX8gSoZrcJI6hulIdqsJ2aL-jJajic6gzOuHmgt2CVl8pxNCb78u7_awb-HduQHV4maAchXE1VU0CbE8s9nJkebIX2t6SlwZe-8OP_0-5e3XNIvPfi51C2AqX_ViiEBQ1zAM7VFexM3ag_Sm5aNkq9F_ZGL9MqiqOJ6mG1uhGsLWNBM9H7rnPVi5BSqgnDPDslqN-vc3hrvkwFWNV7je7dtJ7u16rl4S7S1lZBYjW-7d9urIn9wu1KzDHifcC_5xh0W2YIg%3D) the disastrous impact of Pelosi’s inflation-fueling agenda on OH-01 families, saying, “what does it matter?” ([Cincinnati Enquirer](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6kqjQyxV5fjFW3Ja6oDAOmpHnNAfcTjDihBOetaRDPcYWIzMi-Homj4Pwi4yEWgUk2ZYivwjfM15nYRQtwR4S90AvwFipp9TSy4c2dyPMuGhNDPMU3n_60ju6jjenzqI3I1OESM93Q4i_Cls36-FHnvhd8EW4psOMMzgjOlw4_2dk4YLlthFez0iu3C34YWFsL3AhoN_AjgvuyUYqwzNaMNdwpRuFMI9JtJAzemogxbFn4EI_LIvm22CLXBueLorGXWOo_RknfMCigIaHPp7TXHSk-PpSFPMCWnGydAcpv6FYuJHhP0XBJ-Van10rF0AaA%3D%3D), 5/3/22)

* Landsman supported Nancy Pelosi’s recent plan to hike taxes on people making less than $400,000 and hire 87,000 IRS agents to target middle-class families. ([Landsman for Congress](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6jWv6NG4ta7pFHwN-E2-6bb6X1Ghvud80oP3atZkT-aVABaa52n77VF9mlVwL5r401Kg-s_WwUulWGRtMPsI99ebmKofT6Z1a57AnEMlsN077BKu_g8ruCWD9OZDdq0mPF8hYpA_IpzpRXNGAx9TRPVdtlAsggQbvfMj8SyccF6XooYHxTsn7NdF4JYEdiTlTWXsabifHYWgrC9tH2rtD3ccX3g_NzyhT1RarDMOBKMAcneATynfTYtzJJwRU-Qc_X6_qmQewBAaZz7qoVSy4Sk%3D), Twitter, 8/8/22)

_Landsman Has a Demonstrated Track Record of Raising Taxes, Costs and Fees on Ohio Families and Small Businesses_
* On the City Council, Landsman voted to raise taxes and fees eight times, including increasing taxes on middle-class families and small businesses.

* Landsman voted for a $7 million property tax increase in January 2018. ([Cincinnati Enquirer](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6kqjQyxV5fjFW3Ja6oDAOmpHnNAfcTjDihBOetaRDPcYR5gw4t_I7LAw1qv1kARhnE8T66zzn6D-cwI69f92K1HOhRCZVQ1zplUReGXiwyN9frDPOnDWJ5zVvS4uyAfm9JYmFiEoRvyERaN09SLB61-sh0aRvHiVv_Z3CgIIL9nA0or0F3b4haVppH9RZ_GwRYD9izHl9AIAOEu17RYmF755ndYoWBxpp0oJHrIW_mdd2jL_MkY5ohNFt4V_CHDR4D_HUJq6P02HcfYsNuWFnpvX-VLMeRCEtj2bEvddb2yLpW5g23d9dAFA981KEKYXKg%3D%3D), 1/10/18)

* Landsman voted to approve seven tax and fee increases in June 2018. ([Cincinnati Enquirer](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6kqjQyxV5fjFW3Ja6oDAOmpHnNAfcTjDihBOetaRDPcY6gXE5T1SkG0FTc8Cfv6QUi0OzLfW0XKZGXQpYzhHSGWL965WnI9PIt58A2UPtrTIQzfkqLQoWjPmKu3a6hi-W_Q8EGUQeZkbVQ8EVAsyraIbhkDQRViLNoa7FMvBUuafkvH-DohQhkfkTF4_pG9tfCt_COQWnyAu5Sa-y50XdLeGyDlY0SxclvycCFryq3Ef66GAyKtKoiiXaKJEt72YZyUnxGL_BcCdXzjSXjstf1AQ-Rhw7QPfjMF6z33dHvXO7qC6f50Uf6VS638KwHG1lA%3D%3D), 6/28/18)

* Landsman called for increasing the county sales tax, which would hit hardworking families with higher costs on almost everything. ([Cincinnati Business Courier](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6kHBjgWcbi755o5V6ZUhIQMILRiC3-pIlmBVlkZvPztQMghjkOsBNgZrbU9HAJONAzETksVP3conI7NIeRlHOyG2pzkPdwvcRuMfzsTDzd81bCeOSZCn1bKk0qeFQJbqZBWHpT4uBNb38SxZLyTYob5iRmV228ftzOmgkAzEZnKHxtOvlBCfPOnhZkV5KFJ_uybcR7qcBu5yKhx0Of2efrzLcEgP2vE5eOT7I-V-VdNnRLjqOJI5lbWsHW7ULu_wMO8IHYP0rQDSLO9TesgU8zjixllRVfLA4fh-s9zgoGB3), 11/3/17)

* Landsman voted for “five years of water rate increases.” ([Cincinnati Enquirer](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6kqjQyxV5fjFW3Ja6oDAOmrn48wo4qPpxb2-R_488-49K1bvrTCszAqci3_Stou-XU1BqA-7Nj0OmnISyd6smim_ikXeDQldqmWCSc5ajn4P2jCzr9LHbNnRLnAp_eMoWZ5RDK7QsLLrMgxg4nbr6XedMl88N5YSDYNqhyu61V8lIwn0F5WCTs8bmdq1yHWABOE0BHA-HzY9PUrYlsMj2RUdK93ZOK5CkOKO6RX9VqZ10YbTqX7VvbRU0bBNwVZ0Ii_QqibYzf8uxcJuIcxomGk%3D), 6/23/21)

* Landsman repeatedly supported tax hikes and higher costs on hardworking families and small businesses, while failing to pay his own taxes, getting slapped with a judgement for unpaid taxes earlier this year. (Hamilton County Clerk of Courts, Accessed 6/28/22)

**CONGRESSMAN STEVE CHABOT: FIGHTING TO ADDRESS INFLATION, REDUCE GAS & ENERGY COSTS, SUPPORT SMALL BUSINESSES AND LOWER TAXES**
* _Chabot is Fighting to Address Inflation, Lower Gas & Energy Costs and Support Small Businesses

_
* Chabot is fighting to reduce gas and energy costs and unleash American energy production, including by cosponsoring the Make Energy Affordable Act to require the Biden Administration to publish a report on rising energy prices in the U.S. and outline actions that can be taken to reduce prices. ([gov](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6rqapAh6Bvf1sgRf4pNXZDRYw-CqFjCuivsV1AqN4zrg3UFFn76R2Rycst5f8nNSygnbOZTJltbmH4DdSFkPrFHzMzk0z4VD6rnROvyUvz6m50FyVaiOsvAmg_UOkqHQlqeABWKiD1maWPwXK-3tElIW65SHdekA3MYNoiyIG0D_LxEE8W1Flkbs1P6w6T47G_DSFErH99fPM4OqUjXGm1rQBvpC4t5VI9FgM3aHQWtSAAB6pRWe_iWdesvJoy1cBw%3D%3D), H.R. 6298, Accessed 8/25/22)

* Chabot is working to address the supply chain crisis that contributes to inflation and hurts small businesses, including introducing the DRIVE Safe Act which would alleviate the shortage of truck drivers by making it easier to transport goods across state lines and remove barriers to entry ([gov](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6rqapAh6Bvf1sgRf4pNXZDRYw-CqFjCuivsV1AqN4zrg3UFFn76R2Rycst5f8nNSymGUvhbd4U1UXjzuZ7c-9d-iwCmw6T3fjnAn0yYfVJyCFqcN2_GvHivRNha2savDDVXIpr11phAs7CWMxFJhwFYzlDAncH64JfW0uN9hGPUTrXf73vMo0PspK93SFTxIHKffFeo5QwoZ05AllKKpEoecXCyxJ4RlnxAcsWchaxir), H.R. 1745, Accessed 8/25/22)

* Chabot helped pass the landmark CHIPS Act that will bring economic growth and thousands of jobs to Ohio while also addressing supply chain issues due to shortages of semiconductor chips manufactured abroad. ([Cincinnati Enquirer](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6kqjQyxV5fjFW3Ja6oDAOmqaUJeO843W5M-8w-LikefF9QR0tpNK9YksUXZhJyZ-M9WiUENtKFvlsuB2C7aTZGDfh0MvXhptkOaJyYz5UFMcf0gBIatkHpuFKzcyMj-z8YHrIurbr6AU0QMPy_hsZxfWuH0LEpE8Dn9FqLJOahkhaXlOD9_WmnvXalCx8M7YylFd0rkl3GajPVT-3v0pV3RPmY7jhha7B6gk6VQ5bxGPTBox922S4DHFl-GjY7ResoFdU4YbsXoecb3pQFyjUhiHy_iuaik5iWCAVudMHsSh), 8/4/22)

* Chabot is a longstanding champion for small businesses and the opportunities they create for Ohio communities. Chabot is endorsed by NFIB, the nation’s leading voice for small businesses. ([Chabot for Congress](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6o2Dy743EQAt5O-wDwSvs8JoJvvjWyYsLqZlc3TpBrQFy1lHotkYfvzkfp7dLAGWiidezE2xGBvW9DwiFPewWM59Y7kjzVzyjTf2U27yVBNS4gjzG5ALdYUVwXpCzo1sWS5c4kRqoC0AnmIrZFLMSGyDroE4ou_fnyzb8Wkxed0ev-mzBmBx0_uRbqm0zfZINEGUgefhkVEt02WHdc7A6GEJ0fR4lUBUMyzyBJkBVrZZntKA2oflcLRBmpOa6Gx2Xdape5tHikOuA9r3CnvaVts%3D), 8/1/22)

_Chabot Lowered Taxes for Hardworking Families & is a Leader in the Fight for Responsible Government Spending_
* Chabot helped pass the historic Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 that lowered taxes for middle-class families. ([gov](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6rqapAh6Bvf1sgRf4pNXZDRfqHJbKP9s2St-frXDlXXcxs7qqmXE4rXc1_Bt6uAMohy7KBXWUCqyyWHHKmZTgY3M0jtV4OfKr3Rl2C9YWfTsjwmYzjdVkQT6Ajk9yoZENwqV0_YR77fzDKr49AHxomMpMMZ4_7-gs5fMawj-ZCZgkLM4jdO-Ti-BGuBa7ex8h4tOD_8z4869rkn4SyK1qvwRO4st1zvmn_gD_YuW35P0), H.R. 1, Accessed 8/26/22)

* Chabot is a longstanding advocate for responsible federal spending that would help address inflation and reduce the national debt, including introducing a plan to force Congress to balance its budget. ([gov](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6rqapAh6Bvf1sgRf4pNXZDRYw-CqFjCuivsV1AqN4zrgs1fV4LFi9H9cYX2CmGiuw5F0dAyQWrenUa_2jU1Qr249F86gXzpzCVYDN9Hr07f1uvK15-wPpUpto9tbtA8zU2h-gzzl_v7DDhvGhvvU7vZAg3qlT-ViosFmkrCPZAqzTbM_x6aNVOII_2BH6-CNtpNTu1MiOjhTYkEHW-Ero-xTG05IA0BKQZp5EIAMBi9mJ6VQjsfMVRYdRo37JBhvZw%3D%3D), H.J.Res.3, Accessed 8/29/22)

You can follow Congressman Steve Chabot's campaign on [Facebook](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6qmttjLfOrIme7VVaDnp2ZY5YNU6uoXhlGRhjrL4Jy2bXxHXxXIrSUhQv4VD_vXl6OqtAe4Xs2kTJH0HikqoYp59meEWyl1isSO_9tSDmI5hANLtfYeQEhA8A3xlWUlI8uKr4y9lYGwTxrl0Ed3Fy2wEz9n2sQ12CzDhxN3z7eFXF8E9nCgvHX1I11dkJA5LOjcHEer7tcvOdgVqDBQr3yg%3D), [Twitter](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6uq6Xa7aETfLTlGJU0cwq0yKHXJR651aLmWgBC78WueRNOIkcK3TrrKcTiPljLQhW1pLUPh4P8vqFtyJn9XmLNPRptaKtILBKmVhFoCjrgqFpF3M447XSes4yA1axcqe6sYQPcms9RvCvnLvXha6xVV3rObApqNKovzJyJ39bHGJ6NDJ8ndbUAagKgdLuf_sRw%3D%3D), and by checking for updates on his [campaign website](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=9222623b54374550a66bf62b52c19fd2&_e=C3anLJWCGxRFilDk45QF6o2Dy743EQAt5O-wDwSvs8LbK-Y5lF1YsVhIr0tx7hhqjHeRsdF61Fu16_QUSWU4_roB5ES2hn3wUS0TfHmGKb6xRvQ1SFJARpxNZYlbIqEN13lMzOOaamGsnKGkYe41p5kOn26SUUMBrdGh24-MGFuVv61wbNBjyqaWvKHkBcDMDeu1__QRWQ6Xqqz4WEVolQ%3D%3D). ###
