Peter,

My name is Catalina Lauf and I have a passion for people, public service and fighting for our American values.

I’m running for Congress in Illinois’ 11th Congressional District, but before I get into that - **I’d like to tell you a little bit about my story.**

My mom worked three-jobs at minimum wage to emigrate to America and became a leader in the community. My father grew-up with parents who barely made it through the Great Depression – yet started his own business and became a successful entrepreneur.

**My parents taught me the value of hard-work, liberty and to have an unapologetic love for our Country.**

I worked in the private sector (and still do for a growing startup!) and was a Presidential political appointee at the U.S. Department of Commerce, working on small-business initiatives, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and pro-growth policies.

| | It is no secret that Washington D.C. is broken. Too many politicians spend more time on their favorite cable "news" shows than they do working for the people. Not me. I wake up every morning dedicated to making sure that Northwest Washington is included in the investments Congress makes, and I work overtime to see it through. I want to let you know about three projects I am especially proud of. Working with my colleagues and our local community partners, **we have successfully delivered over $50 million in local infrastructure investments — for the Lummi Island Ferry, the Poplar Way Bridge, and the Whatcom Transportation Authority.** The Lummi Island Ferry carries thousands of people each year, and is the _only_ mode of transportation to and from Lummi Island. The ferry is sixty years old and is in desperate need of 21st century upgrades. I have successfully delivered $25 million for an electric-battery hybrid and related infrastructure for the ferry. This new battery will ensure the ferry provides reliable transportation for decades to come, while reducing the carbon footprint of the ferry. I have also delivered $25 million for a new six-lane bridge over I-5 in Lynwood. The Poplar Way Bridge is a project long in the making, with stakeholders at the local level coming together in advocacy of this vital project. The new bridge will ease congestion, which in turn will boost the local economy and reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Lastly, I am proud to announce that the Whatcom Transportation Authority (WTA) has been awarded $8.8 million to replace eight aging diesel buses with eight new electric buses, plus charging stations. The addition of eight electric buses establishes Whatcom County as a climate leader, reduces pollution, _and_ encourages bus ridership. I have been advocating for electric bus fleets for several years, and am proud to see that come to fruition in Whatcom County. Northwest Washington is the most beautiful corner of this country, and a great place to live, work, and raise a family. But keeping it that way takes hard work and commitment from all of us. I did not do this work alone, but with a coalition of dedicated public servants who got up to bat for Northwest Washington. I am proud to have delivered these investments to our district and grateful to my colleagues and all the community partners who helped make it happen. OK, back to work! _Rick_ |

name: =?utf-8?Q?Douglas=20Carswell?=
subject: Why no water in Jackson?
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-8132600?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear #VALUE!,
An American city of 150,000 people is without running water. Pumps at the main water treatment plant in Jackson, Mississippi failed this week. Low water pressure means that many homes and businesses can’t even run the taps. Those that are getting a trickle are advised not to clean their teeth with it, let alone drink it, since it is likely contaminated.

How did this happen?

Jackson city leadership would like you to think it has something to do with all the recent rains we have had here in Mississippi. Speaking somewhat cryptically at a recent press briefing, Jackson’s mayor, Chokwe Lumumba, said the water-treatment facility had been “challenged, as it relates to these flood levels”. Putting the blame on the rain, he went on to say that the city’s water administration was trying to “figure out how they contend with that additional water that is coming in”.

Officials in neighboring towns and cities, such as Madison, Flowood and Clinton, managed to figure out how to supply residents with clean water despite having just as much rain.

Unless the laws of physics are different in Jackson, the only logical conclusion one can draw from this fiasco is that Jackson’s water problems are a consequence of systemic mismanagement.

Two thousand years ago, the Romans figured out how to supply a city with running water by putting it in pipes. Jackson today seems to be struggling to master this technology.

Key water treatment plants in the city did not employ qualified personnel to run them. Now they have stopped running. What did city authorities think would happen?

For years, city authorities have underinvested in Jackson’s water infrastructure, to the point where it is now falling apart. This, some will be quick to tell you, is because of a lack of money. But why is there not enough money?

In 2017, Jackson’s water billing system collected $61 million in revenue, and the operating costs of the city’s water system were about $54 million. That left a healthy surplus that competent management might have allocated to meet maintenance costs.

This year, the amount of revenue collected is likely to be closer to $40 million, far below running costs. Not only is there no surplus to go towards maintenance, there does not seem to have been much maintenance even when there was a surplus.

How on earth does a city water authority manage to lose almost a third of its revenue in the space of five years? In large part because the city authorities have not collected revenue since they have lacked an effective water billing system.

Several years ago, Siemens was contracted to create a new billing system, while at the same time upgrading much of the city’s dilapidated water infrastructure. That arrangement ended with Siemens being sued by the city for $89 million.

Was that large dollop of Siemens’ money given to the city used to improve Jackson’s water system? Twice as much was spent on attorneys ($30 million) as went to improve Jackson’s water and sewage system ($14 million).

Given what happened with Siemens, I worry that Jackson might not be able to find a contractor willing to undertake the herculean task of fixing the city’s water supply, even if the money could be found. I also suspect that any large outside contractor prepared to undertake the task may want to ensure that they were free to subcontract with their preferred partners on the basis of value, and not to be subjected to various ‘contract rules’ on the basis of politics.

Without some sort of outside support, Jackson’s water crisis will not be resolved. Our’s may become the first state capital in America where it becomes impossible for residents to take a daily shower.

At the state level, Mississippi’s Governor Tate Reeves, who lives in Jackson, has stepped in. He has taken on the task of providing emergency water distribution to local residents – and offering state money to pay for half of it.

The federal government also seems keen to help out. President Biden specifically mentioned investing in Jackson’s water system, during the passage of the Infrastructure Bill. But as Representative Bennie Thompson has sensibly suggested, for the federal authorities to step in “the city to come up with a plan”. Representative Thompson is right.

The federal and state authorities seem willing to act. The key question is whether Jackson’s city leadership is willing to let them come in alongside.

Along the way, Oregonians shared their priorities with me. Time and time again, I heard firsthand about how our landmark legislation will lower drug costs for seniors at the pharmacy counter, make real investments to tackle the climate crisis and create good-paying clean energy jobs. This new law will make a real difference in the lives of families across our state and the country. We've made great progress on health care, student loans, tackling the climate crisis, and making sure corporations start paying their fair share. = We've seen what can happen with a Democratic majority in the Senate, and it's clear if we want to make even more progress on the priorities that matter to American families, we need to expand our majority to get it done. subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zmp520o6pmh82ms8m92is1ddlvpu3t8no9fuj00o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onmelo62orks5r68c3m6oo66dj469h39cr3mmomao3he2om1cr56qoe5d3h6hoefduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9kmdiefcjlcoqe5cr4suobapbi46h22sh2s8i66or4cjhmaoj6cjh2bs)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zcuckpb6q3fjvkgck9phc67emnoj31mg1nab7f60_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhmaoj6cjh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---
| |
* * *
---
|

A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z9umt6vag5vsqsesrd0fu7p5cpc1peaqf47k4uqo_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhmaoj6cjh2bs "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?")**_

Peter,

The Florida Seminole County GOP office was vandalized over the weekend with the words “eat s*** Fascists” smeared on the windows.

It's no coincidence that this vandalism comes after Joe Biden called conservatives “semi-fascists.”

When asked about Brandon’s “fascist” comments, his henchman Charlie Crist doubled down saying Biden was just being “honest.”

Didn’t Charlie just last week declare he doesn’t want the vote from anyone who supports Governor DeSantis because they have “hate in their hearts?”

They talk a big game about unity, but has anyone actually seen any real attempts from the Left to unify the nation? We’ll save you the search, the answer is no.

Leftists worked hard at locking you down, indoctrinating our children and making our communities less safe, but their efforts fall short of working towards unity.

That’s because they’re not interested in a unified nation. They’re interested in perpetuating chaos and destruction across the country and treating people that don’t agree with their radical agenda like second-class citizens.

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zsgu90697kvmiv0i25p7id2dfogvon6051v2kg98_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhmeo32c1h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdojfsksevkv3rs7918bujubv0mqof4vljd8jono_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhmeo32cth2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

subject: US House Minority Leader Endorses Erik Aadland
body:

| Congressman Kevin McCarthy Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(August 31, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Minority Leader of the United States House of Representatives Kevin McCarthy.

Congressman Kevin McCarthy serves California's 23rd district and is currently the Republican Leader in the U.S. House of Representatives. McCarthy was first elected to Congress in 2006. In Washington, McCarthy fights every day for the constituents of California's 23rd District and for the future of America with the simple promise: to have the courage to lead with the wisdom to listen.

At the age of 21, McCarthy started his own small business, Kevin O's Deli, from the ground up. As he worked hard, hired employees, and enjoyed success in his community, he soon learned--as all small business owners do--that the margins are thin, the hours are long, and that often Sacramento and Washington are obstacles, not aids, to success. The redundant and frivolous rules along with tedious paperwork and overburdening taxes compelled McCarthy to enter public service.

After he was elected to Congress in 2006, McCarthy quickly became Chief Deputy Whip and later served as Majority Whip. In 2014, he was elected Republican Leader in the House, where he now leads Congress in fighting for individual liberty, an efficient and effective government, free markets, and a vibrant civil society.

Since McCarthy was elected to Congress, he and his Republican colleagues have blocked the largest tax increase in American history, cut out-of-control government spending, passed bills to create jobs, promoted North American energy independence, and fought to free Americans from the meddlesome influence of Washington in health care and beyond.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, McCarthy said:
"Americans deserve safe communities and opportunities to prosper. Erik Aadland understands how to resolve the crises keeping us from that prosperity. That is why I am pleased to endorse him in his bid to become my next colleague from Colorado's 7th district. As we face out-of-control inflation and crime, it is more critical than ever to elect responsible leaders to represent us in Washington. Erik is that kind of leader, proven in both his military and civilian careers. He will come to Congress ready to provide solutions. I look forward to working with him."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I am greatly honored to receive Congressman McCarthy's endorsement. He has been a reliable voice of reason and an excellent example of legislative leadership for many years. I am enthusiastic about partnering with him to end the economic and public safety problems we face due to failed policies from the radical Left in Washington. "

---
| |

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWucrg-hcN

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWucrg-hcN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
fellow American,

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

Today it
asserts itself in many forms-including critical race theory-in
our government, in our K-12 schools, in our corporations, in the
media, in sports, and even in our military.

The
recent election in Virginia brought the corruption of American
K-12 education, in particular, to the forefront of our national
conversation.

The
breakdown (especially among younger Americans) of informed
patriotism-without which self-government is impossible-is not
something we can allow to continue.

While
there is reason to remain hopeful, there is much work to be done
to reverse the current trends in the months and years ahead.

Education
is where this attack on America began-and it is the battlefield
on which we must engage the Left in defense of liberty and
limited constitutional government.

Hillsdale
College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades. We
are now determined, with the help of supporters like you, who
agree with Hillsdale's mission, to redouble our efforts at this
crucial time for our nation-no matter the cost.

That's
why we are expanding our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by
Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

You can
support this vital project through this link:
https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

The
Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching
Millions will give informed patriots across the country the
effective ability to defend liberty through education. And we
need your help.

The
project has three key objectives:

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, our digest of liberty, to
reach millions more Americans.

Increase the number of citizens (especially younger Americans)
enrolling in our free online courses, such as "Constitution 101:
The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope," and our newest course, "American
Citizenship and Its Decline" with Victor Davis Hanson.

Launch additional Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 charter
schools nationwide and provide, free of charge, our American
classical K-12 curriculum (including the new Hillsdale 1776
Curriculum) to thousands more American teachers and
homeschoolers.

And your
generous support is critical to our success. Here's why...

Hillsdale
College conducts its educational outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty-as it does all of its work-while refusing to accept one
penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of
federal or state student grants or loans.

So, to
expand this effective program, we will need thousands of gifts
between $25 and $100. This is the range in which most supporters
give. We will also need a significant number of $500 to $1,000
donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

We
urgently need your help.

You can
safely and securely renew your support using this link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

As the
forces of anti-Americanism redouble their own efforts to
undermine informed patriotism in our schools and our culture, and
to subvert constitutionalism in our government, we must engage
them ever more aggressively-including on the central battlefield
of education.

That's
why I hope you'll make your most generous gift in this critical
year for America.

Every
dollar you can give will help expand our Project to Defend
Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

Thank you
for your generosity. I hope you'll stand with us. Together, we
will work to preserve freedom for future generations of
Americans.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

I’m gonna talk about growing up in Pennsylvania, but first, I have to ask: **[Can you split $5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50044078/364407650/-88209209?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1957-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGUyNzExZi01ODI5LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VRMJN6zp_MITrtzVl0sRSMB6tydeW3sRG0fImMs3-bE=)****[between me and Jacky Rosen to help fund our General Election campaign before our urgent end-of-month deadline? I’m *so* grateful for your support (even if you think Wawa> Sheetz). 🙄](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50044079/364407652/-88209209?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1957-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGUyNzExZi01ODI5LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VRMJN6zp_MITrtzVl0sRSMB6tydeW3sRG0fImMs3-bE=)**
Ok, now onto the good stuff.
I was born in Reading, Pennsylvania when my parents were just two teenagers starting out on their own. I love my parents, even if Gisele is their favorite.
We started out struggling. My dad was a union grocery worker at ShopRite, working night shifts. The union way of life helped keep our family together while he went to college. Dad ended up graduating, and got a good job as an underwriter.
After we moved, I grew up in suburban south central Pennsylvania. I graduated from Central York High School and went to college in Reading, just like my dad did.

body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbo6ejj5rs79fuqc0fr3gjmpm1hguk6rfjdugeo0_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm1o74cth238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm8p79d9j6iprect66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2umq38dr6mjiefdtlmdpj1cj0eqo68p326pi3cphkm3jr6pb4sspnfchj6tg72s37q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjhcopb1ddkcurm2phhe2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8iv0)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z72ce5t1vvmt152ri8rk2c64p5d8sgk93fmibbro_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm1o74cth2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---
| |
* * *
---
|
---
A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvb0h4a06qpe20iq11t1q7a8kc3st6ea7ejieomg_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjhm1o74cth2bs "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?")**_

I believe your children are your children. Not the State’s children.

This is why this election in November is so crucial.

We must protect our children!

Team, here’s the truth: I spent days before the launch of our poll worker recruitment campaign worrying about its success. I know it’s a big deal to ask our supporters to spend their Election Day volunteering.

But I was blown away by how many of you stepped up! We’ve already recruited over 2,200 poll workers. I’ve never felt more confident about the power of this team.

We’re just starting this program though -- and we haven’t raised all the funds it will take to run it along with all of AOTL’s other efforts. For the poll recruitment program alone, there are trainings we still need to develop and materials to provide volunteers.

[**Will you chip in whatever you can to make sure we don’t run out of the resources required to run our poll worker recruitment campaign and any of our other democracy-saving programs?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50051362/364418178/-1863468049?refcode=20220830_AOTL_F_PollWorkerCampaign_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA4NjcwMDFmLTVmMjktZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=p6ZMEst2U-f7tipaHUg8muSLvYZ719HvJklEIgZuQLQ=)

1. Folks across the country understand how grave the threats to our democracy are. [**They feel what A.G. Holder is talking about when he says “Democracy is on the ballot this November.”**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50051364/364418180/-1863468049?refcode=20220830_AOTL_F_PollWorkerCampaign_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA4NjcwMDFmLTVmMjktZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=p6ZMEst2U-f7tipaHUg8muSLvYZ719HvJklEIgZuQLQ=)

The supporters [**signing up to volunteer to be poll workers**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50051365/364418181/-1807428003?refcode=20220830_AOTL_F_PollWorkerCampaign_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA4NjcwMDFmLTVmMjktZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=p6ZMEst2U-f7tipaHUg8muSLvYZ719HvJklEIgZuQLQ=&emci=56941ac4-a828-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=0867001f-5f29-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=8431045) are heroes for our democracy, but so are the supporters funding democracy-saving work.

clean_body: The world seems to get crazier every day. More than ever, we need to stick together and help each other. | | | | | | Dear PragerU Supporter, The world seems to get crazier every day. More than ever, we need to stick together and help each other. That’s our philosophy at PragerU. We continue our work come hell (CRT propaganda, the sexualization of our children) or high water (inflation, recession, or stagflation). If you have seen any PragerU videos, you know we provide much needed common sense content to millions of people 24/7. With inflation and economic uncertainty, many people are not able to give as much as before. But if you give today, your 100% tax-deductible donation will go 3X further and have TRIPLE THE IMPACT. The PragerU team is more committed and working harder than ever to educate young people about our nation’s founding principles and values. Those values have sustained America through hard times. They will do so again. But dark clouds are gathering. We've been getting troubling emails from some of our most dedicated online supporters. Because of the economic downturn, some are saying that they will not be able to help us with a donation this year. Sky high gas prices and bigger grocery bills are overwhelming them. Some have even lost their jobs. About 40% of PragerU’s donations come from individual, online donors, so it makes perfect sense we are tracking behind our budgeted goal. But, this is not the time to scale back our efforts. This is the time to scale up! We need your help to fill this gap. In the midst of this terrible uncertainty lies an opportunity to educate Americans, who are spending more time online than ever before, about our shared ideas and values. The better-funded left will use this opportunity to diminish our voice. They are working together right now to find the money to bury our ideas--simply by rapidly investing in their ideology far more than we do. That means your $50 gift to PragerU turns into $150. Your $250 gift turns into $750. If you give $1,000 to PragerU, your impact explodes to $3,000 in funding to change millions of young minds --and millions of young lives--for the better. | | | | | | | | The question is: Will we allow the left to take advantage of every single crisis as a chance to grab ever more government control? Or will we fight back and help save the future of our country by spreading the pro-American values of PragerU to the next generation? Help us make up the gap for those who can no longer afford to give this year. If you were planning to give at the end of the year, please consider giving now. Please consider an automatic monthly recurring gift to help us ride out the bumps in the financial road! Together we can succeed. We know that your heart is committed to our work. I still remember how striking it was for me that in the face of the second worst disaster in U.S. history, the first thing that I heard from all too many was, “Are you up for reelection already?” That, of course, represents a democracy that has not been working for them. **Our leaders should be depositing into our communities, not just reaching out when they need your vote.**

Houston is at a critical juncture where we can either move backward or choose to move forward, and I couldn’t be more excited about the prospect of leading Houston to a place where everybody has the opportunity to thrive.

As a native Houstonian, attorney, and former At-Large City Council Member, _I’ve seen firsthand the challenges Houstonians are facing_ and understand that our city is at a crossroads. From balancing our city’s budget and curbing our rising crime problems to tackling Harvey’s damage and flooding that still plagues us today, Houston needs experienced leadership to face our city’s challenges head-on. I know I can be that leader for you, team.

In the aftermath of Harvey, I spent my time mobilizing hundreds of volunteers to check in on our most vulnerable community members because that’s what servant leadership looks like. I continue to assist with our recovery and empower our communities because our communities deserve to be served and empowered. **Now, I’m running for Mayor because service is a mission for me, team.**

clean_body: Our city is at a juncture where we can either move backward or choose to move forward. | | | | | Team, This Sunday I had the opportunity to join Newsmakers on KPRC to discuss my candidacy for Houston Mayor, and how my experience and vision will help propel Houston forward. When Hurricane Harvey struck five years ago, I went door-to-door to canvass our low-income senior communities to prevent them from being left behind. I still remember how striking it was for me that in the face of the second worst disaster in U.S. history, the first thing that I heard from all too many was, “Are you up for reelection already?” That, of course, represents a democracy that has not been working for them. Our leaders should be depositing into our communities, not just reaching out when they need your vote. Houston is at a critical juncture where we can either move backward or choose to move forward, and I couldn’t be more excited about the prospect of leading Houston to a place where everybody has the opportunity to thrive. As a native Houstonian, attorney, and former At-Large City Council Member, I’ve seen firsthand the challenges Houstonians are facing and understand that our city is at a crossroads. From balancing our city’s budget and curbing our rising crime problems to tackling Harvey’s damage and flooding that still plagues us today, Houston needs experienced leadership to face our city’s challenges head-on. I know I can be that leader for you, team. In the aftermath of Harvey, I spent my time mobilizing hundreds of volunteers to check in on our most vulnerable community members because that’s what servant leadership looks like. I continue to assist with our recovery and empower our communities because our communities deserve to be served and empowered. Now, I’m running for Mayor because service is a mission for me, team. Peter,
With the General Election just over two months away, it’s been a really busy August on the campaign trail. Our efforts to reach voters have been nothing short of nonstop. Our field team and volunteers are knocking doors and making calls. Our operations guy is putting out signs and setting up events. And our fundraising folks are, you guessed it, fundraising.
We know we’re building momentum. We see it in volunteer sign ups and in our conversations with voters. We even got a poll back that shows this race is a dead heat!
But we also know the supermajority rigged this map to steal a seat in Congress, so we’re not taking anything for granted.
We can emerge victorious in November if we have the resources we need to reach families like yours! Our campaign is fighting to protect our freedom to build a good life and leave a better future for our kids.
Meanwhile Andy Ogles and his Trump Republican allies want to take away freedom from everyone who does not look, live, or love like them — and take our freedom to start a family on our terms, not theirs.
I’m so grateful to have such amazing supporters and it means even more to know that the majority of this campaign is being funded by individual donors. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=48bdad934b7a479f9cd8b9b8d01850d1&_e=H3cARytgd16wLafLApSZpm9uuesmvQAqWkQEpeZxp4DBvVWd93Eqi-_SFMtKMbGjyMkUY2Xm5tp1yu3WiTJvGWzmhnk-IXNFosUI0XCCP4ex_itEcr_tqbS1rAKRXE0ns7R5RoGY7FXa1xTJBl6nxAQLQ95IWaU9UuAYQfcn8VosvrHMJWoksn22DaGEqZ6oV2tVrU4rHH0g3SFvmPkOsT6HxzP25zJYkwWnXF-ariKV9up-c-BjQwXuUZ4v58zV9PYcO7SRJi67F0UG1MRQVCNgMmJTEWyPUykufqN5VYjgfj43il0MdbKMTXTeKCtupxSS4bxNuYa1Y33yM_OoCw6MBHab8ZEQ42ELvkQ05Sxr6JOCfZ6V-38kG5DjsFCa3KAaOmmnL_Hv9N5Hg9o5UGdq-N6gBsUORkeXIMhGEhU%3D "Johnson1")**_

[Our democracy is on the line—and we could lose it if we don’t act now.

Former President Barack Obama said it best, asking, **"do we allow our democracy to wither, or do we make it better?"**

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: I will be so much more than just a fighter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
I am asking as a nurse, as a Missourian, and as a mother: Please, help me prevent any more of the heartache than this crisis has already caused.
| | |
---
Peter, today is International Overdose Awareness Day, and it's clearer than ever before how much our leaders must still do to address this crisis.
This is personal to me. After a years-long battle with addiction and 499 days of sobriety, I lost my beautiful son, Matt, to an opioid overdose. And my four sons and my daughter lost their beloved brother.
But I know my story isn’t unique. I know my pain and heartache are shared by too many. **That's why I believe it’s time to make addiction recovery a priority in Washington.**
I always see political messaging that asks folks to send them to Washington because they'll be a fighter. And you can absolutely count on me to fight tooth and nail to make our communities safer and to tackle this epidemic – but I will be so much more than just a fighter.
**I am asking you to send me to Washington to address this issue because I am a nurse – I know how to heal wounds like these.** I've helped patients suffering from the illness of addiction through their indescribable pain.
**I am asking you to send me to Washington because I've spent my life serving Missouri, one of the states most impacted by opioids in the entire nation.** Today, one out of every 54 deaths in our state is caused by an opioid-involved overdose. I know the communities that are hurting most because they're my community.
**And finally, I am asking you to send me to Washington because I am a mother who has grieved this exact loss firsthand.**
Folks say there is no one more protective, fierce, and determined than a mother who's defending her children. And although I lost Matt, I am still fighting for him _every single day_. I could not view this issue with any more seriousness or personal conviction.
So today, I am asking you to send me to Washington to tackle this, not just for my kids, but for all of our kids. **I am asking as a nurse, as a Missourian, and as a mother: Please, help me prevent any more heartache than this crisis has already caused.**
**[As we mark International Opioid Awareness Day today, I'd like to invite you to read my plan to tackle the opioid epidemic. It's informed by experts, by communities, and by personal experience, so it'd mean so much to me for you to take a moment to read it.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50054788/364432868/-1366166328?refcode=jtk178-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNTFmOTYzMC02ODI5LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q2NX71zQ0oznmvehlb_xshd2EOnWY4TEfdL4hGHy1is=&emci=e7b8fb6b-b128-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=051f9630-6829-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**
| | [Read My Opioid Epidemic Plan](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50054789/364432869/-1366166328?refcode=jtk178-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNTFmOTYzMC02ODI5LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q2NX71zQ0oznmvehlb_xshd2EOnWY4TEfdL4hGHy1is=&emci=e7b8fb6b-b128-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=051f9630-6829-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)
---
To those of you who've experienced this epidemic firsthand, I promise that I will always stand with you, fight for the justice you deserve, and work toward a place of healing and peace. Together, I know that we can end the opioid epidemic and win a brighter future for our families.

– Trudy

Wisconsin’s future is at risk

| [ ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_1_v1&n=1)
---
Hi Friend, I’m Ali, a College Republican and intern working for Team WisGOP. **TODAY** is our August end-of-month fundraising goal, and I wanted to tell you **_just how important your help is for Wisconsin’s future._** My peers and I were locked out of school by Tony Evers and our college campus suffered at the hands of the unrest in 2020 that Mandela Barnes praised. My generation is at a crossroads; if we keep heading down this fringe-left path led by Tony Evers and Mandela Barnes, **Wisconsin’s future for my generation is at risk**. | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVjTcWbdiKas98vEmmVr841Es7z8xnyAnByRcUilHRvRo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_1_v1&n=2 "HELP US FINISH AUGUST STRONG") [HELP US FINISH AUGUST STRONG](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVjTcWbdiKas98vEmmVr841Es7z8xnyAnByRcUilHRvRo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_1_v1&n=2)

Friend, there’s only one thing my generation truly wants: **_Freedom._** **Freedom** from lockdowns, **freedom** from burdensome taxes, and **freedom** from government. It’s clear that Ron Johnson and Tim Michels are the candidates ready to give us that freedom, which is why they must win this November. [**_Will you please help us reach our August fundraising goal to help them win?_**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVjTcWbdiKas98vEmmVr841Es7z8xnyAnByRcUilHRvRo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_1_v1&n=3)

We have today and today ONLY to reach our August fundraising deadline. **As the fall semester approaches, I know we need to be full steam ahead if we want to get out the young Republican vote.**[**_Will you please help us?_**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVjTcWbdiKas98vEmmVr841Es7z8xnyAnByRcUilHRvRo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_1_v1&n=5)

Dear PragerU Supporter, The world seems to get crazier every day. More than ever, we need to stick together and help each other. That’s our philosophy at PragerU. We continue our work come hell (CRT propaganda, the sexualization of our children) or high water (inflation, recession, or stagflation). If you have seen any PragerU videos, you know we provide much needed common sense content to millions of people 24/7. [**August is PragerU's fundraising month and from now until August 31, generous PragerU donors have committed to tripling all donations—thereby TRIPLING YOUR GIFT!**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zoj5rf6jpqk18v42uudqrq23lgjcf66tvvnr66vg_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjjm6p76cjh2bs) With inflation and economic uncertainty, many people are not able to give as much as before. But if you give today, your 100% tax-deductible donation will go 3X further and have TRIPLE THE IMPACT. The PragerU team is more committed and working harder than ever to educate young people about our nation’s founding principles and values. Those values have sustained America through hard times. They will do so again.

But dark clouds are gathering. We've been getting troubling emails from some of our most dedicated online supporters. Because of the economic downturn, some are saying that they will not be able to help us with a donation this year. Sky high gas prices and bigger grocery bills are overwhelming them. Some have even lost their jobs. **About 40% of PragerU’s donations come from individual, online donors, so it makes perfect sense we are tracking behind our budgeted goal. But, this is not the time to scale back our efforts. This is the time to scale up! We need your help to fill this gap.** [Can we count on your tax-deductible support today to help us continue being your voice and fighting for everything you care about? Your gift today will be TRIPLED and have TRIPLE THE IMPACT.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfe3g4u4jfi09a0smqpmrgm0k5rgvnd0r521ojl0_rp22sh2s8i66or4cjjm6p76cjh2bs) In the midst of this terrible uncertainty lies an opportunity to educate Americans, who are spending more time online than ever before, about our shared ideas and values. The better-funded left will use this opportunity to diminish our voice. Summer

Mark Milley, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, should be subject to an Article 32 Hearing under the provisions of the Uniform Code of Military Justice for his conduct and statements as memorialized in the Bob Woodward book “Peril,” and the Aug. 8, 2022, New Yorker magazine excerpt of a forthcoming book by Susan B. Glasser and Peter Baker. An Article 32 Hearing is the military equivalent of a civilian grand jury, and should probable cause of the commission of a crime be established, it would lead to Gen. Milley’s court-martial. The Army has an affirmative duty to maintain good order and discipline, especially with regard to senior leader misconduct. History provides an example of a senior officer engaged in misconduct. Assistant Chief of the Army Air Service Brig. Gen. Billy Mitchell was court-martialed in 1925 for remarks to the press concerning two deadly military aviation accidents. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. body:
|

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** August 31st, 2022 Contact: Michael Gordon [Michael@brandonforcongressny22.com ](mailto:Michael@brandonforcongressny22.com) **Congresswoman Elise Stefanik Endorses Brandon Williams for New York’s 22 nd Congressional District ** **SYRACUSE, NY** – Congresswoman and Republican House Conference Chair Elise Stefanik today announced her endorsement and full support of the GOP nominee for New York’s 22nd Congressional District: Brandon Williams. Rep. Stefanik’s backing signals the entirety of the Republican Party coalescing to send Brandon to Washington. **Congresswoman Stefanik issued the following statement regarding her endorsement:** “I'm proud to endorse Brandon Williams for Congress in New York's 22nd Congressional District. Brandon honorably served our nation in the Navy, and as an entrepreneur, he understands first-hand the challenges facing New York small businesses under one-party Democratic rule," **said Chairwoman Stefanik**. **Rep. Stefanik added:** "The path to the House Majority runs through New York and this district is absolutely critical for Republicans to hold. I know that Brandon has the energy and fight to win and the real-world experience to deliver for Central New York families. Brandon has my full endorsement, and I look forward to working with him to keep this key seat red!" **In response to the endorsement, candidate** **Brandon Williams responded with the following:** “I am honored and humbled to be endorsed by the great freedom fighter, Congresswoman Elise Stefanik. I look forward to working alongside Rep. Stefanik to combat President Joe Biden’s disastrous policies, reduce the impacts of inflation, lower crime, and ensure the American dream is attainable once again for all Central New Yorkers.” ###

body:
Dear fellow Precinct Delegate,

Have you been wondering how you can make a difference? Kristina Karamo has had supporters statewide host fun **Patriot Party Fundraiser** event's once a month and our next one is **September 12, 2022! **
You may be wondering what's involved? It's actually pretty simple. You can make your event as little or as big as you wish. The idea is to invite some friends and family into your home, or business, or barn (yes, people have done all of the above) for a fun filled evening together. Some people have co-hosted with someone else which has worked out well too. It's always nice and refreshing to spend time with others that are like minded & concerned, just as you are, with where our state & country are headed.
The event starts at 6:30pm and around 7:15, Kristina will join your event via Zoom to share why she is running for Secretary of State, what she plans on doing once she is in office and to answer any questions you and your guests may have. Our biggest Patriot party had 30 host homes statewide!
**We are getting down to the wire and we need to connect Kristina with as many voters as possible.** This is the goal these Patriot Parties; get to know Kristina better, connect every supporter with the campaign so they can engage, and to help support her financially to get her across the finish line.
This will be our 4th party & they have been very successful & a blast! We'd love for you to join us.

subject: Closing up shop 👉
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter, you know I hate to be negative.

There's truly no one who believes in this campaign more than me, which is why it kills me to say I may have to _**[call it quits.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61156848:J50UooVNx:m:1:3253819041:E8546E01A0C1E3BC88024056F48AAE3E:r "call it quits.")**_

My finance team just sat me down and delivered some devastating news... _**we 're about to come up $4,750 short of our August goal.**_
---
| | [HELP MEET TIFFANY'S GOAL](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61156848:J50UooVNx:m:1:3253819041:E8546E01A0C1E3BC88024056F48AAE3E:r "HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL")
---

Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns.

I'm genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don't see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn't be more severe and is why I'm asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

I'm a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I've spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq.

Unlike my opponent, I haven't spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that's precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I'm bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I'll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won't put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We're creeping into the final hours of this month's deadline, but I know that we'll keep this campaign going with your support.

_**[So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight's deadline?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61156848:J50UooVNx:m:1:3253819041:E8546E01A0C1E3BC88024056F48AAE3E:r "So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making
campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s deadline?")**_

I really hope you understand where I'm coming from.

I promise I wouldn't reach out like this if it weren't the end of the road.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

Tiffany Smiley

Since the August primary, we have felt energy from fellow Democrats who know what’s at stake here in Arizona. The AZ GOP has no limits to their extremism, while our candidates are out meeting voters and sharing solutions.

We have the momentum, we have the polling numbers in our favor, and we have quality candidates that will do the work needed to win.

name: Becca
subject: This is the last time you’ll hear from me on our General Election Fund
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Becca Balint for Vermont, P
body:
Hey Peter – If you told me a year ago that we would be bringing in nearly 500 contributions in less than a month to my general election fund, I wouldn’t have believed you. The sheer people-power behind the movement we’ve built together is nothing short of amazing. I’m so grateful for the support you have shown me following our incredible victory earlier this month. Peter,

I am writing to ask you to [split a donation between my campaign and The Collective PAC,](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zGifeFRrn5KNHQ_e4wTEeIDQQ2AhwAajboBvY0dN44ZkWxp4-YO_4Y-Kea8mSdzdErsovVGMeJANqWtemYEVFlaO5aOXCHb1v7k8XSaH9RQald6P4igDABJ05k8baJBB1f05XGjguXLDnGUL0QdOVzy0NSXs3BCm-3OjV7boy72UsHclo_G-sCnhnjX8TKM2UmBYIaIImbZ4HAJ0qYfvgvRa0VUhTtuxkCLSKqLRNybnW9u_d0T80-IAPsmJC7E9I-FYQbWpb1So44ZDOZn0daTQSlWUhoyWRBiJK1aljbrMZFNXSS9X_WZbepiYeH3-4eJ2KbHy307FhEoi1CT6ifhNUtQzH7M6xG7y5xQmfsIw/3p2/BS3MU-a-R62WBtkzfvz8Vg/h2/tngOcSKeUu-8yK67LO4EcEHvUPORx74LtJWAZGsb4zE) but first I want to share with you a story that illustrates why I am in this race.

When I was growing up, we only had one car, so my dad would sometimes have to hitch rides or walk for long stretches of the 30-mile trip home from the shipyards where he worked.

One rainy night, Mom got worried. So we piled in the car and went out looking for him. When we found Dad walking along the road, he was soaking wet and shivering in his shirtsleeves. He explained that he had given his coat to a homeless man he’d met on the highway.

Why did he give away his only jacket? Dad told us the reason in the car that night: “I knew when I left that man, he’d still be alone. But I could give him my coat, because I knew you were coming for me.”

None of us succeed alone — when times are tough, we can persevere because our family, friends and neighbors will come for us.

[Together, we are coming to build a better future for all Georgians, where they know they are supported by their leaders. If you'd like to unsubscribe | | Peter, I am writing to ask you to but first I want to share with you a story that illustrates why I am in this race. When I was growing up, we only had one car, so my dad would sometimes have to hitch rides or walk for long stretches of the 30-mile trip home from the shipyards where he worked. One rainy night, Mom got worried. So we piled in the car and went out looking for him. When we found Dad walking along the road, he was soaking wet and shivering in his shirtsleeves. He explained that he had given his coat to a homeless man he’d met on the highway. Why did he give away his only jacket? Dad told us the reason in the car that night: “I knew when I left that man, he’d still be alone. **I was 17 when the World Trade Center collapsed, and like many Americans, I felt a deep sense of patriotism and a duty to serve our country.** At that time, homophobic policies like “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” discouraged me from joining the military, so I decided to study law.

**After law school, I came home to California and clerked for two federal judges.** Then, as an Assistant U.S. Attorney, I helped prosecute white-collar criminals who defrauded seniors, thieves who targeted disabled victims, and corrupt doctors who perpetrated the opioid crisis. I also handled cases in counterintelligence -- including shutting down a smuggling operation that sent American-made microchips to China.

**In recent years, I’ve learned firsthand that some of the biggest threats we face are right here at home.** The January 6 attack on our capitol didn't happen by accident, and as a federal prosecutor working on related cases, I saw how extremists in Washington and media outlets helped contribute to the violence and division that’s eroding our democracy.

**My opponent Ken Calvert has been one of Donald Trump's most outspoken supporters.** He perpetuated the Big Lie that the 2020 election was stolen, and within hours of the attack, Calvert voted to decertify the election results.

**My campaign is about stopping extremism so we can get to work for the American people.** We need to agree on basic facts. Only then can we move forward on the things that matter -- improving health care access, growing the economy, and saving our environment from the climate crisis.

**[I’m committed to getting our democracy working again. That starts by ousting extremists like Ken Calvert who fuel and benefit from the chaos. | | | Peter My name is Amanda Adkins. I know your inbox is probably flooded with emails, so I’ll be quick: [My friend Regan Deering is officially the Republican nominee running in one of the most competitive races in the country. Election experts just gave Democrats a SLIGHT EDGE in her race but I KNOW in my heart of hearts she WILL win this key race if every Patriot donates $10 now!](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=c12f6ce66f&e=2fa613cb76) Why? Because Regan is not just another one of the D.C. insiders who wants to be a career politician for the rest of her life. She comes from a background of being a teacher and a small businesswoman. **She knows what America needs right now, and it’s NOT liberal indoctrination in our classrooms or higher taxes. ** We need a secure border. We need to take care of our veterans. We need to get inflation under control. We need to hold Joe Biden accountable. We need to focus on election integrity. And most importantly, we need to take back control of Congress from the liberal Democrats. **And if she wins her race, we certainly will. ** But Regan has a lot of hurdles in front of her. First of all, she is running in what we call an OPEN SEAT – that means it’s vacant. And it’s also extremely competitive. By all accounts, Democrats plan to spend a fortune in this race to install a Democrat and edge me out of the race. They have over $100,000,000 to spend in battleground races according to the latest FEC reports. [This race is going to come down to the wire for these reasons. That’s why I urgently need your help. ](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=963a866d74&e=2fa613cb76) Regan and her team are working around the clock to reach new voters and turn them out on Election Day, but that can be expensive. They’re running ads, printing flyers, knocking on doors, making phone calls, and sending texts. **That costs a lot of money. ** Like I said, she can AND WILL win this race. But she’s going to need your help to do it. So, I’m personally asking you to complete a small donation to help fund these critical voter contact operations. When a race is THIS CLOSE, even a little bit goes a long way. Please consider investing in Regan Deering’s campaign to win back control of our country. All the best,
**** Amanda L. Adkins
_Official Republican Nominee, KS-03_
****

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. name: Aadland For Congress
subject: China is working to diminsh US
body:
The CCP is not our friend
| | | |
---
---
|
# China's efforts to diminish U.S. power and influence
---
|
---
---
| | |
---|---
|
The Chinese Communist Party (CCP) is a despotic regime with eyes on global domination, and there is no doubt that China regards the United States as an adversary. We need look no further than their plan known as the [Great Rejuvenation of 2049](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001icdC0E-6L8LqaxBAhFigEwkE-fn08vIA4O7MgA_AXsEJ7QFMdzcohidTD1AJJ5iTQ9jdLxoIuJY0mctq1nu_vq7zA6sOxRMnCzvTMyPJM8F7zsKnLQVKpLsJFJaJnKvKoRiRKTmzvuC-BpU3SceTf57lT-sZ2B2POF_G3LM4nZ0Vbcvc9bY-3mdWVdja7i4MmvQKkg1L43_7bOCbR0_gsBzytpDf4lVgrd7HdPvUWdo=&c=aH96BS_hcTpR4uVcQ0MiheWzJTjBY7hhIZNVEytW6NIf3nLTtsEKAg==&ch=hXf6nXI-wSFH4pJP87dyIM1RyAagpz88djaJugsmijd1JzVrbu5rrg==) to see how they are committed to supplanting America's partnerships and alliances in the Pacific region, with an eye towards becoming the sole superpower in that part of the world.
America must prove her strength in order to turn back this challenge from a purveyor of an unfree world order. There are three key ways this must happen: renewed partnerships and alliances in the Pacific region, bringing the rest of the Western world into our efforts, and reining in companies that are U.S.-based but caving to pressure from the CCP. It is critical that our leadership in Washington recognize the grave threat posed by Chinese aggression and act to counter it before it is too late.
We must reduce our dependence on China economically, shorten our supply chains, move American companies and jobs back to the United States, and develop sources for rare earth metals outside of China and preferably within the United States. Ultimately, our economy should be independent of China's influence. I propose that we also pass legislation to prevent foreign entities from China and other hostile countries from purchasing US land.
| | |
---|---
|
China is not simply competing with the United States with the intent to move her economy ahead and improve the lives of their people. The CCP leaders are intent on international dominance. They are willing to use the full spectrum of their government's power to achieve that goal, including economic strong-arm tactics and military intimidation.
One example of China's efforts to disrupt the status quo in the Pacific has occurred in the Solomon Islands. The small nation, with a population of about 700,000, signed a security agreement with China for no obvious reason. Indeed, the Solomon Islands already has Australian troops present in the country for the very purpose of security.
| | |
---|---
|
China, however, stands to gain potential military basing opportunities and [perhaps the purchase of a major port](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001icdC0E-6L8LqaxBAhFigEwkE-fn08vIA4O7MgA_AXsEJ7QFMdzcohidTD1AJJ5iT38FMGsBDc1iWCR3UI3PA1tLDQ6nI_Mdz-OuIzmZQZ1BSzEvZiGEDkYkNRW19D_BgknPP_chKQoqrldxvlArqnWPdvJKvre1nVxPDPmo_2BhUfTDmkhQl-PrIpjnsC-kjSSsMqRJZjdDf7EF4VJKzTRQ9EqsyVOqf7j1bTDhregg=&c=aH96BS_hcTpR4uVcQ0MiheWzJTjBY7hhIZNVEytW6NIf3nLTtsEKAg==&ch=hXf6nXI-wSFH4pJP87dyIM1RyAagpz88djaJugsmijd1JzVrbu5rrg==) just 1000 miles off Australia's shores. Thus, the CCP has used dubious diplomatic cover to gain leverage over a bigger target. The greater method and strategy is clear: take small geopolitical steps that can later be used to coerce concessions from countries that would never otherwise be bullied by the tyrants in the CCP.
China is also using broader economic means to squeeze other nations. For instance, China is the largest creditor of Sri Lanka's foreign debt. With [Sri Lanka having defaulted on that debt](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001icdC0E-6L8LqaxBAhFigEwkE-fn08vIA4O7MgA_AXsEJ7QFMdzcohidTD1AJJ5iTkMX4vfw39YRZw6JuXAfJW_uv-3ml8uwqhxrm8rcx7cpAmfrYyT1NQyZd3Ll6NJJdcgj3IndFHozkIT3v1QRwZ5Rjn6Z8UBl_1hA61ssOulz4ffvUaomYLlj4EDsxErwtLNFw78YsoqY=&c=aH96BS_hcTpR4uVcQ0MiheWzJTjBY7hhIZNVEytW6NIf3nLTtsEKAg==&ch=hXf6nXI-wSFH4pJP87dyIM1RyAagpz88djaJugsmijd1JzVrbu5rrg==), the country is now at the mercy of China.
Previously, China built and financed Sri Lanka's Hamabantota port in 2017. While the port was "a money loser," China leveraged this fact to sign a 99-year lease of the port "[as part of a plan to convert (Sri Lanka's) $6 billion debt to Beijing into equity](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001icdC0E-6L8LqaxBAhFigEwkE-fn08vIA4O7MgA_AXsEJ7QFMdzcohidTD1AJJ5iTj9_mppjd0EtKTCLod85ngcD1xfDzfbY6hVkREAaHPVUP9kadn0y-H_IFWpn3YcMfjRvzsi_nQ85GmtnQijcSqR1Hg6dXBWKEe_er0OA7GKL5oMZtrdXplb4pO6h26x041oc8kDeAZYtyQI5_o29ZT7rKmbgWYlLVZGcb3ybNPSFiw6BmluZwg612-hjPgPnHJydmXXw0xh0=&c=aH96BS_hcTpR4uVcQ0MiheWzJTjBY7hhIZNVEytW6NIf3nLTtsEKAg==&ch=hXf6nXI-wSFH4pJP87dyIM1RyAagpz88djaJugsmijd1JzVrbu5rrg==)." China is, in effect, the owner and director of all activities at this port. Team,
The day we’ve been warning you about has arrived: the Super PACs are officially going up on TV in our district starting this week. Two separate Republican Super PACs have launched ads in the 7th district this week. Together, they are set to spend more than $1,000,000 on TV attacking me – and that’s just this week.
There’s a reason I talk about outside spending: my opponent simply isn’t raising enough to be on the air as much as we are. In fact, right now his campaign is scheduled to do very minimal TV this week, and none in the weeks following – he is relying on the super PACs' dark money to speak for him, potentially for the rest of the campaign. He is banking on attack ads to do their job and sway voters against me, rather than talking about positive things he wants to do.
In contrast, my TV ads speak for themselves, focusing on the issues that matter in this race and to mid-Michigan. And because I don’t accept money from corporate PACs, I’m only able to produce them because of the generosity of the engaged and dedicated grassroots supporters who chip in when they can. So, if you’d like to help us produce more of our own messaging and push back against the negative super PAC ads, you can make a contribution below. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
Hi Derek,

I just got done putting my kids to bed, so I thought I would take a second to let you know how much I appreciate your support.

This campaign has never been about me, it’s always about you, and all of us in this together. That’s why it means so much to me to know that I have you on my team.

Western Pennsylvania deserves a fighter in Congress, and Derek, I promise that’s who I’ll be for us in Washington. I’ve taken on hard challenges before, risked my life for this country, and they’ve all prepared me for the fight of my life: Fighting for our common good in Washington.

But to get to Washington, we have to win in November, which means consistently hitting our monthly goals, growing our grassroots team, and reaching out to all corners of Beaver and Allegheny counties. It’s going to be a group effort, which is why I have one last ask for you, Derek.

We only need to raise $450 more to reach our August goal. This would set us up for victory in November, so if there’s anything you can chip in, I would appreciate it:

Chris

subject: sharing my thoughts with you in these final hours
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Fairness Project
body:
Friend,

In just a few short hours, we’ll reach our midnight deadline and enter the thick of election season. With less than 70 days until voters decide on each of our measures, I’ve been thinking a lot about how these campaigns could go — especially our fights in Michigan and Vermont.

Since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , we’ve seen extremist politicians from all across the country play twisted political games that have put the livelihood and safety of Americans in grave danger. Like me, I’m sure you’ve seen the headlines — women whose doctors have to rush to contact a court official before they can perform a lifesaving procedure, cancer patients who have been denied treatment because that medicine is also used in an abortion.

People’s lives are at stake and these politicians are OK playing games with them. Well, friend, we’re not.

People everywhere are starting to wake up to the power of ballot measures. They’re seeing in real time how they can win the protections, policies, and progress they need — and no longer have to rely on politicians and their partisan games.

Winning our campaigns in Michigan and Vermont sets the stage for other states to use ballot measures to protect or restore their access to abortion. And friend, this work will save lives.

Winning these campaigns is only the first step. If you’re with us as we fight to protect abortion and make history in the process, please consider donating before tonight’s deadline to help us meet our goal.

I know that together, we can do this.

— Kelly
