This morning, the [Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=ez1BnRg01gPGR4qyG5PO2LV_3pMbUHIlFBrsZcCPouMY56iXwJLM5qB_PC47au0b8tbnc8PT5SVrjXZYYriDOBIg4x9mcjCziuT1gm81_7LuF9WUmMNXkQgMWVIkwDbtrIWj1eoZlQF_F-Yjy1KY22c0Srg586yfh8Ab115lTYT-SGzRSq7gzH1gOle3zxKu2mnRnF5QZXppbUKFp_pCR8HJVkzW9Yje_sidGOrfkK8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mjs_v1&n=1) and their affiliated USA Today- Wisconsin papers attacked Tim for his decades of charitable giving – particularly to Christian causes. [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=ez1BnRg01gPGR4qyG5PO2LV_3pMbUHIlFBrsZcCPouMY56iXwJLM5qB_PC47au0b8tbnc8PT5SVrjXZYYriDOBIg4x9mcjCziuT1gm81_7LuF9WUmMNXkQgMWVIkwDbtrIWj1eoZlQF_F-Yjy1KY22c0Srg586yfh8Ab115lTYT-SGzRSq7gzH1gOle3zxKu2mnRnF5QZXppbUKFp_pCR8HJVkzW9Yje_sidGOrfkK8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mjs_v1&n=2) Here are some of the organizations that the corrupt media and Tony Evers are trying to smear:
* Wisconsin Right to Life
* Pro-Life Wisconsin
* Veritas Society
* New Beginnings Pregnancy Centers
* Avail’s Crisis Pregnancy Centers
* Christ Fellowship
* Spring Creek Church
* Sisters of St. Francis of Assisi
* Faith Lutheran Church and School
* Rare Cancers Research Laboratories at the Medical College of Wisconsin

These organizations do so much good for our fellow Wisconsinites. They help women find places to live when they are in an unplanned pregnancy, educate Wisconsin students, provide families a place to worship, and develop cures to cancer. Tim and Barbara voluntarily chose to support them with their own funds. The corrupt media is trying to spin this into some act of evil. Of course, the Journal Sentinel did not examine if Tony Evers donated to charity at all. Instead, they attacked Tim and his family for giving to Christian causes. Let’s be clear, it’s not just his faith that is under attack here. It’s yours and mine. What can you do? Help SHARE the truth on our Facebook post by clicking [HERE](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6pOa_jPCOozcMV6SuBWw6qPX08VL4wPo-otBlzzgUWLWN0JPJhhVnRL7ahS7Tcq23R7xSHJXDKTyIfFY9DmopB4&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mjs_v1&n=3). For 4 years, the corrupt media has turned a blind eye to Evers’ failures and are now all-in as accomplices to demonize conservatives like Tim. Like you. They are now so desperate they are attacking the family’s charitable giving to churches. Assaulting the reputations of Catholic nuns, some of the largest churches in Wisconsin, and even cancer research is shameful, and the people of Wisconsin should not tolerate this disgusting, anti-religious bigotry. It’s time we all fight back. Thank you,
Patrick
Campaign Manager

I’ve emailed you, texted you, called you, maybe even knocked on your door, but now I really need you to pay attention. Republicans do not have this election in the bag, and if you’re tired of Democrats bad policies that you and your family are paying for everywhere , then we need to step it up immediately. The bottom line: Democrats are outraising Republicans 2:1 and amped up to keep their majority. If people don’t start paying attention to critical races, we will lose the House AGAIN and give Pelosi, AOC, and my opponent, Angie Craig two more years of FULL government control. I’m running in a toss-up district that is the KEY to the majority and way behind on my fundraising goals - The extended version: I’m sure you know how bad things are... and it’s only going to get worse if we hand Democrats back the House in November. Everything is more expensive--that is if you can even get anything, due to scarcity. Kids are being used as political pawns. Our God-given rights are being threatened. And the Liberal media has NOTHING to say about Democrat’s failures. What you may not know is just how important this Minnesota race is. Democrats and Republicans alike have marked this as a top-five targeted seat, because my ultra-radical incumbent opponent is vulnerable - which is why Democrats are investing millions of dollars in her. In 2020 when I ran for this same seat, I lost by just 2% - sending my opponent to Washington (where she voted with Pelosi 98% of the time). We cannot afford to fall short again when there is so much on the line. So, now you see why I had to email you and ask for your immediate support. We are entering into the most important midterm election of our lives. What happens now, will determine what our kids futures look like. This November election will determine the future of America. If that is not worth fighting for, I don’t know what is. I often ask myself, what would have happened if I would have emailed one more person or made one more phone call - I may never know. Maybe it’s the Marine in me or just my go-getter spirit, but I’m not leaving anything on the table this time around. The stakes are just too high. Winning this race, means winning back the House. It’s time to fire the Congressmen and Congresswomen who have consistently put our country LAST - starting with my opponent. Please, Fellow American - pay attention before it’s too late. body:
The truth is I’m reaching out today with a request today because we have an important fundraising deadline in just a few days.
#

First and foremost, I want to say thank you to everybody who has supported our grassroots campaign. I am so grateful to the more than 100,000 people who have helped us get to where we are - less than 3 months from making history. It is humbling.
The truth is I’m reaching out with a request today because we have an important fundraising deadline tonight. Will you please consider making a contribution to our grassroots campaign to help us hit our ambitious goal of 25,000 donations? Please use this link to give:
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-aug22?refcode=em220831-3**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220831-1-MA&t=1&akid=1616%2E357359%2EJUcfGE)
We’re heading into the final stretch of this campaign. Right after Labor Day, everything kicks into an even higher gear. Senate Republicans’ outside spending is going to increase by millions of dollars.
Look, their super PACs can spend millions on false attack ads against me, like they’ve already done. But I refuse to back down because this seat and our next Senator’s vote should not be for sale.
My opponent Ted Budd thinks he can just let special interests buy this seat for him, and in return, he’ll continue doing exactly what he’s done in Congress — voting to keep the system rigged in favor of billionaires and corporations. He will fight for a future where abortion is banned in every state, where marriage equality is overturned, and where economic inequality only gets worse.
I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward. I will never hesitate to do what is right in the U.S. Senate — justice for the people will be my North Star.
But the truth is I simply cannot do this alone.
[**So I’m humbly asking you to make a $3 contribution to our campaign today to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority. Our August deadline is almost here, and it is critical that we reach our goal and raise the resources necessary to compete with the super PACs trying to buy this seat.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220831-1-MA&t=2&akid=1616%2E357359%2EJUcfGE)

body:

---
| |
---
| | Peter,

We've heard from so many supporters the urgent message, "get on TV and combat Tim Walz's lies!" **Well, tonight at midnight is critical**! The ads are being shot, the buys are being made, and we're close to getting up on TV to get our message out. [Please help us fund these ads. Any amount helps!](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=7b841425ce&e=33b11688c1)

Keep in mind, the DFL Money Machine already [has $20 Million to spend against us](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=c08eac6247&e=33b11688c1)! We have the grassroots momentum on our side, but we need _every_ dollar you're willing to give to at least be competitive. If everyone reading this email [gave just $25 before our $10,000 midnight deadline](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=7997475870&e=33b11688c1), **we would be fully funded through the rest of the campaign!**

If we can hit $10,000 yet today, that means when we can amplify our message:
* [Help us get up on cable in the Twin Cities](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=6ae5fa448d&e=33b11688c1)
* [Help us expand to the Duluth and Mankato markets](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=0255e9997b&e=33b11688c1)
* [Help us get on network TV in Rochester](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=2ad29d1f1d&e=33b11688c1)
* [Help us launch an ad for the Vikings/Packers Home Opener](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=102ca7e7ef&e=33b11688c1)

We _cannot_ do this without you. We don't have the backing of giant special interest groups, big pharma, big tech, or big government. In fact, our campaign is vey much a threat to them! _But what we do have is a movement of WE THE PEOPLE._

Will you help us today? [Will you give $25, $125, $1250 or more before midnight so we can hit our TV budget goal?](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=f75a148452&e=33b11688c1)

Thank you for your consideration and generosity! This campaign is about returning YOUR voice to St. Paul and getting our state back on track.
---
| In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for Governor - Minnesota

# [Border Patrol Busts Hundreds of Adult Migrants Posing as Minors to Dodge Deportation](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60024&L=27954&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYm9yZGVyLXBhdHJvbC1idXN0cy1taWdyYW50cy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1jb3JydXB0aW9uK2Nocm9uaWNsZXMmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==)
As if the crisis along the southern border were not bad enough, adult illegal immigrants are posing as minors to enter—and stay in—the U.S. since typically those under 18 are welcomed with open arms. The government refers to them as Unaccompanied Alien Children (UAC) and hundreds of thousands have entered the country in the last few years. The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) is charged with caring for illegal aliens under the age of 18 and the agency spends millions of dollars annually to house, medically treat, entertain, and school UAC who come mainly from Central America. Undoubtedly, illegal immigrant minors are almost always allowed to remain in the U.S. and quickly disbursed to a government-funded shelter upon arrival at the border.

Our opponent is attacking us
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220831-3346-header&t=1&akid=3346%2E2526796%2E6xfDqO)
We’re officially less than 10 weeks away from the midterm elections. And **Alexandria is going head to head against a MAGA Republican who’s pulling out all the stops to try and oust our Congresswoman.**
From banners in Yankee Stadium that read “#OustAOC”, to going on Fox to lie about Alexandria – the attacks are ongoing.

| | | *****UPDATE (8/31): Holy cow! In a shocking upset, Sarah Palin has LOST the special election for the US House seat from Alaska, and [Democrat Mary Peltola has won](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdd17b7ea-9647-4751-b902-3c2c483d61b1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)!!! Thank you SOOOOOO much to everyone who contributed to Peltola and helped make this possible! ** **Note, there's another election for this seat in November (because nothing can be simple anymore), and Peltola has to run again, so please take your spare cash, and[send it all to Peltola's campaign](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6dc596c8-1a76-4fc0-b8bc-b697d63d1b2b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). Seriously, she has earned our support, big time!** ***UPDATE (8/19): We've got results from the special election in Alaska, and the good news is, we can still defeat Sarah Palin. In fact, we've got two chances to do it. Here's the details (and remember to [help Democrat Mary Peltola](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf483b0b4-72bf-4447-afa5-ce989b86cd1e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) if you can, because Palin is a blithering idiot, and we've got enough of those in Congress already): [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfad209c8-76d0-423e-8425-9be2c96f6b3f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
* Alaska just held an election to fill the vacant seat of the late Rep. Don Young through the end of this term. There were 3 candidates: Palin, Democrat Mary Peltola, and Republican Nick Begich.
* The election was held using [ranked choice voting](https://default.salsalabs.org/T07a5e03f-a70b-4928-8019-9c15863cf3f6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), in which voters rank the candidates, the last place finisher is dropped each round of counting, and their votes go to their second choice until one candidate has more than 50%.
* With 82% of the vote counted, Democrat Mary Peltola is in first place, with 38% of the vote, Palin has 31.9%, and Begich has 28.6%. It may take nearly two more weeks to count all the votes, but if these results hold up, Begich will be dropped, and his voters' votes will go to their second choices.
* Still with us? Need more coffee? Go ahead, we'll wait.
* Okay, here's where it gets really interesting -- If Peltola gets a little more than 40% of Begich's votes, she will win. Now, normally, you'd expect a Republican voter's second choice to be the other Republican in the race. And yes, the odds are still with Palin, but... the battle between Begich and Palin was fierce, and many Alaska Republicans still resent Palin for leaving her job as governor half-way through, to run for VP. And Peltola's lead could increase as the rest of the initial votes are counted, meaning she'd need even less of Begich's votes. Bottom line -- stay tuned, this could be a nail biter.

But there's more!
* On the same day, Alaska also held a primary election for the _next_ term, the Representative who will serve from January 2023 to Jan 2025. With basically the same candidates, and with the top 4 advancing to the general election in November.
* Peltola is also leading in that race, by a few points, and will certainly advance to the next step.

Bottom line: Peltola could win now, she could win in November, and it's up to us to make sure she has the resources necessary to wage this battle. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Fellow American,

My name is Catalina Lauf and I have a passion for people, public service and fighting for our American values.

He’s letting the real, kitchen table issues affecting all of us here at home (like bodily autonomy and price gouging) go unaddressed while he pockets millions from big-money interest groups to further their own agenda, while families here at home suffer.

Fellow American, it’s Nancy Mace (the high school drop-out got her start as a Waffle House Waitress). [**I need a quick moment of your time.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=703e871910d24556b143894f6a572f80&_e=aGeTlBLQrwM6N-oEjxzaDCjpyJHvioh1mPM9h1ZyyEwGh_SLJo0-eeJSMC_z-oiTbS0Da7WbZeJo0K5FXkiEa4GFhn4C4KcqNJzg0CA7xicAkEvSMskhPlHLT-JznqX5zSXicAmJeraTSrNrhryxYOBKU4SbaM94k3EgxtzGo6GRFbL2OqYgd3g6D2x7-lkIsAx48aLdO4D5jtOOLI4aM5jvi8hFsto4jTte73iGcZxAiFMlQYnSw1op6ainnuC6O5dGqqzZaZ5_4ZjO1gCItMcRWoD6fpQ9vmVqFCoJY-nq7f_BYNN7WOTYQOlvAmEmmzT8Aa8iQgUoenXUWaFJUjLjMSyx_l6i8bSgITH2Qt1jjZh-VLPTx-ONAyzOHtHIOrfBSTvBDE45_XukCkDH0AubS2cNHKjqJbt6uDfNJ5w%3D)

**The short version:**
I’m up against the clock on my monthly fundraising deadline and will miss it unless we take action immediately. Remember, I’m running in a district we barely flipped in 2020, and fighting tooth and nail to keep in red. [**I need to know if I can count on you to help in the next 15 minutes.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=703e871910d24556b143894f6a572f80&_e=aGeTlBLQrwM6N-oEjxzaDCjpyJHvioh1mPM9h1ZyyEwGh_SLJo0-eeJSMC_z-oiTbS0Da7WbZeJo0K5FXkiEa4GFhn4C4KcqNJzg0CA7xicAkEvSMskhPlHLT-JznqX5zSXicAmJeraTSrNrhryxYOBKU4SbaM94k3EgxtzGo6GRFbL2OqYgd3g6D2x7-lkIsAx48aLdO4D5jtOOLI4aM5jvi8hFsto4jTte73iGcZxAiFMlQYnSw1op6ainnuC6O5dGqqzZaZ5_4ZjO1gCItGxyLC3kAzh9YyKv0SvH-PHOyRaUkRHAjapuVUbX919jamx9G2o6PFfNYXXm_ORpJuADacS3bMwWZWhTvuLKhxPUKNPBuNIOwASLEqvyK5GmaXGk7RtUNXMn80T7Ftw5ABKBEPw6jYqXrb0bhaOU1jk%3D)

**The long version:**
This is what I didn’t want to have to send you, Fellow American. I know how bad things are right now. People are struggling to afford rent, buy groceries, and fill up their tank at the gas pump.

I’ve been there. Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck. At 17 years old, I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

I didn’t grow up with millions in the bank, and a silver spoon in my mouth. My dad was an Army General and my mom a schoolteacher. My parents taught me the key to success, **work**. And working is what I’ve been doing since I was 17.

Congress is in desperate need of someone to come in and shake things up – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. _Someone who knows what it’s like to earn a living and make sacrifices._

So now you see why I had to email you today and ask for your immediate support. [**My monthly fundraising deadline is coming up quickly and I’m behind. Will you tap the secure link and make an emergency donation to my campaign to send a hard-working, every-day American to Washington to fight for you?**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=703e871910d24556b143894f6a572f80&_e=aGeTlBLQrwM6N-oEjxzaDCjpyJHvioh1mPM9h1ZyyEwGh_SLJo0-eeJSMC_z-oiTbS0Da7WbZeJo0K5FXkiEa4GFhn4C4KcqNJzg0CA7xicAkEvSMskhPlHLT-JznqX5zSXicAmJeraTSrNrhryxYOBKU4SbaM94k3EgxtzGo6GRFbL2OqYgd3g6D2x7-lkIsAx48aLdO4D5jtOOLI4aM5jvi8hFsto4jTte73iGcZxAiFMlQYnSw1op6ainnuC6O5dGqqzZaZ5_4ZjO1gCItIBsMkpOqVh174GzRj6Lx4-RYkbwfb-NAJJ_A34_DQ-BhnKecu2jU27RbCDhwj2jWqpZ-eQGZbMZtD6bUYMwyUCLHQxuiSQNojbFDtq30y9Hdei4ROlmiXFFdzl1ZoEL8XjB7LKFNLf3jQUVEeIrrG8%3D)

We can’t let the Left buy back this seat – _**the Lowcountry is not for sale!**_

Here’s why that is so important. | | | Peter, we are hitting our End of Month fundraising deadline tonight at MIDNIGHT. Here’s why that is so important. We are going up against a goliath. Monica has already run for this seat once before, has checks from huge mega-donors in the bank, and MAGA Republican support behind her. We’ve been telling you for months, but now we are seeing all those advantages play out. GOP groups have already reserved over $6 million in ads in South Texas to potentially target Michelle and get her right-wing opponent elected. But even with all that, we are still so confident in this campaign — because we have a fighter like Michelle as our candidate, running on a platform made by and supported by the people. Also, because we have supporters like you. Monica’s checks can only go so far. We KNOW that our message and path for the future is what the people of this district want. We’ve heard it at the doors, on the phones with voters, and at events where people drive out of the way to meet Michelle. It’s clear that even with all that cash and MAGA support — Monica is scared of this movement. She STILL hasn’t responded to Michelle’s call for 3 debates before the election. Spoiler alert: It’s because she knows she’ll lose. BADLY. What we have is more powerful than anything in Monica’s corner: People power. Now we need to see that support come in during critical deadlines like this. The work we are doing to reach out to folks both in person and digitally simply can’t be done without your grassroots donations. We need to make sure we have the resources and financial support to fight harder than EVER in these final 68 days before Election Day. That starts with hitting our August deadline. I’m glad I caught you, Peter.
Tonight marks our August end-of-month fundraising deadline. As it stands, we’re still coming up $7,137 short of our online fundraising goal. As a reminder, since I’m not backed by corporate PACs, and our campaign is relying on grassroots contributions to stay on track.
Will you rush in a donation before midnight to help us meet this monthly benchmark?

Here's a good link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50060389/364456060/-295409223?refcode=em-8.31.22-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NTkxMTQ0NS03ODI5LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xW5hYRlIzF0XfvArr3SBBwZLzHzlAJzBhrrmNxvO0BY=)
**This week, we got word that Kevin McCarthy’s super PAC is adding an additional $450,000 in attack ads against us. Peter, this is _on top_ of the roughly $3 million we already know is headed our way.**
There’s a reason the GOP is so worried about IL-17. The latest polling shows us surging in the race, and my opponent Esther King’s extreme, anti-choice positions are completely out of touch with our district.
Put simply, I’m the candidate voters trust. When you work as a local meteorologist for twenty years, you become intimately familiar with the problems a community faces. In Congress, I’ll use my expertise in communication to advocate on important issues from the cost of health care to the impacts of climate change.
We need all hands on deck as we head into the final two months of this race. It’s going to be close, and every grassroots contribution will make a difference.
If you’re with me, chip in to give us a boost in this hyper-competitive campaign. **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50060390/364456063/-295409223?refcode=em-8.31.22-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NTkxMTQ0NS03ODI5LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xW5hYRlIzF0XfvArr3SBBwZLzHzlAJzBhrrmNxvO0BY=)**

Folks, this month has been tough.

After national Republicans started flooding the airwaves with attack ads,
a new poll came out showing that my extreme Republican opponent, JD Vance,
took the lead in our race.

But despite millions in outside spending by GOP groups, this race is still
closer than ever. That’s a testament to our grassroots momentum, and
you’re a big part of our success.

My battleground race will decide Senate control—so we can’t hold back one
bit if we want to chart a new course here in Ohio.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20616?t=1014&amount=25&akid=5294%2E3611125%2EbNHfDJ ]Our biggest End-of-Month deadline yet is at midnight tonight, and we’re
still behind. Can I count on you to chip in $25 so we can close the gap
with JD and flip this open Senate seat blue?

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20616?t=1015&express_lane=true&amount=25&akid=5294%2E3611125%2EbNHfDJ ]Donate $25

bold legislation we need to fix what’s broken.

JD Vance would be disastrous for Ohio and a vote for McConnell’s
obstructionist agenda. He’ll continue to be propped up by outside
interests and billionaire backers that want a “yes man” in the Senate—not
a fighter for Ohio families.

I am Democrats’ best shot at flipping a seat and you can take my word for
it: I’ll work like hell to cut workers in on the deal by winning this
race.

There'll be more attacks and obstacles thrown our way, but
team, I’m up to the challenge.

$500,000 goal before midnight? This is our first major fundraising
deadline since JD took the lead, and we’re counting on folks like you to
step up and prove we still have a major grassroots force behind us.

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your

subject: One last thing:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Wexton for Congress
body:

But Kemp's taken the same coward's route as Mike Pence, fighting to avoid testifying, which almost certainly would help put Trump away. It's a reminder that in the end, the only fealty Republicans like Kemp have is to power and party, and Kemp cares only about keeping his GOP base happy, not our democracy. This shouldn't surprise anyone who followed how he beat Stacey Abrams in 2018, using his position as Secretary of State in Georgia to suppress scores of Democratic votes, particularly among voters of color. He lacked the integrity and decency to recuse himself from refereeing his own election, because, again, what matters to Kemp is not the will or welfare of the people of Georgia, but his lust for power. | | | | | | Meanwhile, you know all about Stacey Abrams. Her tireless work to register voters delivered us two Senate seats in 2020 that have changed the world--from Biden's incredible job-creating legislation to cheaper prescription drugs, taxing large corporations and providing the child tax credit among many other necessary changes for Americans. Abrams has made clear she'll fight for abortion rights and gun safety legislation, no matter how the right-wing Supreme Court tries to steal those rights from us. She is a hero, we need Stacey Abrams as Georgia Governor to help turn that state around, as well as provide another charismatic voice for change on the national stage. [**So please, let me explain why supporting our campaign with a $5 donation before MIDNIGHT is the *most* important thing you can do to help this campaign right now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220831-2?refcode=em20220831-7050&refcode2=7050_434096_dQOUF-&akid=7050%2E434096%2EdQOUF-)

**Starting at 12:00 AM, we’re officially only 68 days from the election.**
From that point on, we’ll have to do everything we can to reach and turn out as many PA voters as possible. Every single dollar you donate NOW makes an incredible difference.

And we can’t forget that this is shaping up to be one of the most expensive Senate races in the country, too. As a team that doesn’t take any corporate PAC money, every dollar you give helps us fight back against the GOP and their super PACs.
With all of this in mind, I’m respectfully asking for your support before the end-of-month fundraising deadline:

Should that happen, Kevin McCarthy - the current minority leader - is looking to be the next Speaker of the House. And as you also may have heard, he’s likely to face a significant fight inside the GOP. As we’ve seen in Michigan and around the country, the GOP is far from united, with the Trump wing pushing against other factions vying for power. So McCarthy is here both to support the three competitive Republicans in the state, but also to help shore up votes for his campaign to become Speaker.
This is just another proof point that the road to keeping the House runs through Michigan – and right through Elissa’s district. You can bet that this is just the beginning of the major GOP figures on their way to Michigan. Fellow Maryland stakeholders,

Freedom,

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Did you see this message from Charles?

We just need two minutes of your time to read his urgent message. TL;DR:
Rand Paul just dropped a new ad, and we have to prime our campaign to go
on the offensive.

It’s the last day of the month, and with just a few hours to go, we need
all hands on deck to reach our fundraising goals and hit the ground
running tomorrow.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18648?t=1001&akid=2424%2E346206%2E-WUQZw ]With 5 hours to go, we’re 84% of the way to our 7,000 donation target
and reaching our $100,000 End-of-Month goal. Will you rush a contribution
of ANY amount right now so we can start September strong?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18648?t=1002&akid=2424%2E346206%2E-WUQZw ][IMG]

In solidarity,

Team Booker

Read Charles’ personal message below:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Peter, it’s
unbelievable. Rand Paul just dropped his newest ad... we watched it so you
don’t have to.

After admitting he wouldn't have supported the Voting Rights Act, Rand had
the audacity to label himself a "freedom fighter."

After introducing a national ban on abortion, Rand says he is fighting to
"live how we choose."

If like me, you're thinking Rand's delusions have reached a new peak, then
I'm asking you to help us fight back and win this Senate seat for the
people. It's time for us to come together and unite against Rand's
reckless propaganda.

We're poised to defeat Rand this November, but it's going to take all of
us. Your donation can put us in a stronger position to him on. We need to
raise 7,000 donations by our midnight fundraising deadline to reach our
August goal.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18648?t=1003&akid=2424%2E346206%2E-WUQZw ]We're already 44% of the way there — we're so close,
Peter. Will you contribute
$5 or any amount so we can maintain our momentum?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18657?t=1022&akid=2424%2E346206%2E-WUQZw ]Contribute $5

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18657?t=1023&akid=2424%2E346206%2E-WUQZw ][IMG]

Unlike Rand, I know what it actually means to be denied your freedoms.

So do the people of Kentucky. We have watched and waited while Rand and
his buddies make empty promises. Meanwhile, our homes flood, our kids go
hungry, and our medical bills pile up.

We simply cannot allow Rand another 6 years in the Senate. We're a real
threat to his divisive agenda, but he's backed by major corporations
funding his warchest.

We have to keep up and match Rand dollar for dollar. So here's just a few
reminders of why your donation matters so much:

1. Rand is a morally bankrupt, self-serving politician. Everything he
does flies in the face of our democratic ideals.
2. As of July 1st, Rand Paul had $9 million in cash to spend spreading
lies about me — and you can bet he'll use every penny trying to take
us down.
3. We're using innovative strategies to run a campaign that builds power
from the bottom up. We never lose sight of the fact that every vote
counts.
4. When I am elected in November, I will make history again as the first
Black Senator Kentucky has ever had.

Every contribution allows us to go on the offensive now that Rand has
dropped this latest ad. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18648?t=1024&akid=2424%2E346206%2E-WUQZw ]Right now, we're 44% of the way to our goal of
7,000 donations. Will you contribute $5 and help us reach
7,000 donations by midnight?

In solidarity,

Charles

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

Hi Friend,
I’m Ali, a College Republican and intern working for Team WisGOP. **TODAY** is our August end-of-month fundraising goal, and I wanted to tell you **_just how important your help is for Wisconsin’s future._**
My peers and I were locked out of school by Tony Evers and our college campus suffered at the hands of the unrest in 2020 that Mandela Barnes praised. My generation is at a crossroads; if we keep heading down this fringe-left path led by Tony Evers and Mandela Barnes, **Wisconsin’s future for my generation is at risk**.
[](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVjTcWbdiKas98vEmmVr841Es7z8xnyAnByRcUilHRvRo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_1_fu&n=5 "HELP US FINISH AUGUST STRONG") [HELP US FINISH AUGUST STRONG](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVjTcWbdiKas98vEmmVr841Es7z8xnyAnByRcUilHRvRo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_1_fu&n=5)
---
Friend, there’s only one thing my generation truly wants: **_Freedom._** **Freedom** from lockdowns, **freedom** from burdensome taxes, and **freedom** from government. It’s clear that Ron Johnson and Tim Michels are the candidates ready to give us that freedom, which is why they must win this November. **_Will you please help us reach our August fundraising goal to help them win?_**
[](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVjTcWbdiKas98vEmmVr841Es7z8xnyAnByRcUilHRvRo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_1_fu&n=6 "FIGHT FOR FREEDOM") [FIGHT FOR FREEDOM](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVjTcWbdiKas98vEmmVr841Es7z8xnyAnByRcUilHRvRo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_1_fu&n=6)
---
All hope is not lost. My peers and I are fighting for freedom on campus. College Republicans are gaining traction and inspiring young conservatives. **We’re doing everything we can to save Wisconsin, but we need those that came before us to help us save the Badger State’s future for all of my friends, your children, and your grandchildren.**
We have today and today ONLY to reach our August fundraising deadline. **As the fall semester approaches, I know we need to be full steam ahead if we want to get out the young Republican vote.****_Will you please help us?_**

Thank you!
Ali B.
